Rooms = {}

local function toWorld(room, x, y, z)
    local r = math.rad(room.yaw)
    local c, n = math.cos(r), math.sin(r)
    return vector3(room.x + x * c - y * n, room.y + x * n + y * c, room.z + z)
end

function Rooms.world(storeKey, p)
    local room = Config.Rooms[storeKey]
    return room and toWorld(room, p.x, p.y, p.z) or nil
end

function Rooms.goodsAt(storeKey)
    local room = Config.Rooms[storeKey]
    if not room or not Racks then return {} end
    local out = {}
    for _, rack in ipairs(Racks.rooms[room.kind] or {}) do
        local r = math.rad(rack.yaw)
        local c, n = math.cos(r), math.sin(r)
        for _, g in ipairs(Racks.models[rack.model] or {}) do
            local lx = rack.at.x + g.at.x * c - g.at.y * n
            local ly = rack.at.y + g.at.x * n + g.at.y * c
            out[#out + 1] = { item = g.item, coords = toWorld(room, lx, ly, rack.at.z + g.at.z) }
        end
    end
    for _, s in ipairs(Racks.spots[room.kind] or {}) do
        out[#out + 1] = { item = s.item, coords = toWorld(room, s.at.x, s.at.y, s.at.z) }
    end
    return out
end

function Rooms.at(storeKey, spot)
    local room = Config.Rooms[storeKey]
    local s = room and Config.RoomSpots[room.kind] and Config.RoomSpots[room.kind][spot]
    if type(s) ~= 'vector3' then return nil end
    return toWorld(room, s.x, s.y, s.z)
end

function Rooms.row(storeKey, cat, n)
    local room = Config.Rooms[storeKey]
    local r = room and Config.RoomSpots[room.kind] and Config.RoomSpots[room.kind][cat]
    if type(r) ~= 'table' or not r.at then return nil end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        local d = (i - (n + 1) / 2) * r.spacing
        out[i] = {
            coords = toWorld(room, r.at.x + r.axis.x * d, r.at.y + r.axis.y * d, r.at.z),
            heading = ((r.face or 0.0) + room.yaw) % 360.0,
        }
    end
    return out
end

function Rooms.store(storeKey)
    for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
        if st.key == storeKey then return st end
    end
    return nil
end

local CORE_NAMES = { drink = 'Water', food = 'Burger' }
function Rooms.goods(cat)
    local list = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
        if it.cat == cat then list[#list + 1] = { key = it.key, name = it.name, picture = it.picture, prop = it.prop or it.picture } end
    end
    local core = {}
    for key, it in pairs(Config.CoreItems) do if it.cat == cat then core[#core + 1] = key end end
    table.sort(core)
    for _, key in ipairs(core) do
        list[#list + 1] = { key = key, name = CORE_NAMES[key] or key, core = true, prop = Config.ShelfProps and Config.ShelfProps[key] }
    end
    return list
end

local _print = print
local print = function(...)
    if Config.Debug then _print(...) end
end

local Camera = {}
Camera.handle = nil
Camera.isActive = false
Camera.initialRot = vec3(0, 0, 0)
Camera.currentRot = vec3(0, 0, 0)
Camera.targetATM = nil
Camera.currentATMModel = nil
Camera.atmCoords = nil
Camera.atmHeadingQuat = nil
Camera.debugMode = false

Camera.cachedButtonCoords = {}

local function Clamp(value, min, max)
    return math.max(min, math.min(value, max))
end

local function QuatFromHeading(heading)
    return quat(heading, vector3(0, 0, 1))
end

local function RotateVectorByQuaternion(vec, rotQuat)
    local vecQuat = quat(0, vec.x, vec.y, vec.z)
    local rotatedQuat = rotQuat * vecQuat * inv(rotQuat)
    return vector3(rotatedQuat.x, rotatedQuat.y, rotatedQuat.z)
end

local function ComputeButtonWorldPositions(atmEntity, atmModel)
    Camera.cachedButtonCoords = {}

    local buttons = Config.ButtonOffsets[atmModel]
    if not buttons then return end

    local atmCoords = GetEntityCoords(atmEntity)
    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmEntity)
    local headingQuat = QuatFromHeading(atmHeading)

    Camera.atmCoords = atmCoords
    Camera.atmHeadingQuat = headingQuat

    for _, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
        local rotatedOffset = RotateVectorByQuaternion(btn.offset, headingQuat)
        local worldPos = vector3(
            atmCoords.x + rotatedOffset.x,
            atmCoords.y + rotatedOffset.y,
            atmCoords.z + rotatedOffset.z
        )
        Camera.cachedButtonCoords[#Camera.cachedButtonCoords + 1] = {
            id = btn.id,
            worldPos = worldPos
        }
    end

    print('^2[atm-dui] Computed ' .. #Camera.cachedButtonCoords .. ' button world positions for ' .. atmModel .. '^0')
end

local function GetButtonAtScreenCenter()
    local proximity = Config.ButtonProximity or 0.027
    local closestDist = proximity
    local closestButton = nil

    for _, btn in ipairs(Camera.cachedButtonCoords) do
        local visible, screenX, screenY = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(btn.worldPos.x, btn.worldPos.y, btn.worldPos.z)

        if visible then

            local dx = screenX - 0.5
            local dy = screenY - 0.5
            local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

            if dist < proximity and dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closestButton = btn.id
            end
        end
    end

    return closestButton
end

function Camera.TransitionTo(atmEntity)
    if Camera.isActive then return end

    Camera.targetATM = atmEntity
    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmEntity)

    local model = GetEntityModel(atmEntity)
    Camera.currentATMModel = nil
    for _, modelName in ipairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(modelName) == model then
            Camera.currentATMModel = modelName
            break
        end
    end

    if Camera.currentATMModel then
        ComputeButtonWorldPositions(atmEntity, Camera.currentATMModel)
    end

    local sideOffset = Config.Camera.sideOffset or 0.0
    local camOffset = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmEntity, sideOffset, -Config.Camera.distance, Config.Camera.heightOffset)

    Camera.handle = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamCoord(Camera.handle, camOffset.x, camOffset.y, camOffset.z)

    local initialPitch = Config.Camera.initialPitch or -15.0
    Camera.initialRot = vec3(initialPitch, 0.0, atmHeading)
    Camera.currentRot = Camera.initialRot

    SetCamRot(Camera.handle, Camera.initialRot.x, Camera.initialRot.y, Camera.initialRot.z, 2)
    SetCamFov(Camera.handle, Config.Camera.fov)
    SetCamActive(Camera.handle, true)

    RenderScriptCams(true, true, Config.Camera.transitionTime, true, true)

    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)

    Whip.core:SetScreenOpen(true, 'atm')

    Camera.isActive = true

    print('^2[atm-dui] Camera transitioned - Model: ' .. tostring(Camera.currentATMModel) .. ' | Heading: ' .. atmHeading .. '^0')

    Camera.StartControlThread()
end

function Camera.StartControlThread()
    local prevButtonId = nil

    CreateThread(function()
        while Camera.isActive and DoesCamExist(Camera.handle) do

            DisableAllControlActions(0)

            SetEntityLocallyInvisible(PlayerPedId())

            DrawRect(0.5, 0.5, 0.003, 0.005, 255, 255, 255, 200)

            local xMouse = GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 1) * (Config.Camera.mouseSensitivity or 4.0)
            local yMouse = GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 2) * (Config.Camera.mouseSensitivity or 4.0)

            local pitchUp = Config.Camera.pitchUp or 15.0
            local pitchDown = Config.Camera.pitchDown or 28.0
            local yawRange = Config.Camera.yawRange or 20.0

            Camera.currentRot = vec3(
                Clamp(Camera.currentRot.x - yMouse, Camera.initialRot.x - pitchDown, Camera.initialRot.x + pitchUp),
                Camera.currentRot.y,
                Clamp(Camera.currentRot.z - xMouse, Camera.initialRot.z - yawRange, Camera.initialRot.z + yawRange)
            )

            SetCamRot(Camera.handle, Camera.currentRot.x, Camera.currentRot.y, Camera.currentRot.z, 2)

            local hoveredButton = GetButtonAtScreenCenter()

            if hoveredButton ~= prevButtonId then
                ATM_DUI.HighlightButton(hoveredButton)
                prevButtonId = hoveredButton
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 24) and hoveredButton then
                Camera.OnButtonClick(hoveredButton)
            end

            if hoveredButton then
                for _, btn in ipairs(Camera.cachedButtonCoords) do
                    if btn.id == hoveredButton then

                        DrawMarker(28,
                            btn.worldPos.x, btn.worldPos.y, btn.worldPos.z,
                            0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                            0.015, 0.015, 0.015,
                            0, 201, 167, 200,
                            false, false, 2, false, nil, nil, false
                        )
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if Camera.debugMode then
                for _, btn in ipairs(Camera.cachedButtonCoords) do
                    local isHovered = (btn.id == hoveredButton)
                    local r = isHovered and 0 or 255
                    local g = isHovered and 255 or 0
                    local b = isHovered and 0 or 255
                    DrawMarker(28,
                        btn.worldPos.x, btn.worldPos.y, btn.worldPos.z,
                        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                        0.015, 0.015, 0.015,
                        r, g, b, 180,
                        false, false, 2, false, nil, nil, false
                    )
                end
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 200) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 177) then
                Camera.TransitionBack()
                break
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

function Camera.OnButtonClick(buttonId)

    if Config.Sounds.enabled then

        if buttonId:match('^side_') then
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, 'ATM_WINDOW', 'HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET', true)
        else
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, 'PIN_BUTTON', 'ATM_SOUNDS', true)
        end
    end

    ATM_DUI.ClickButton(buttonId)

    TriggerEvent('atmdui:client:buttonClicked', buttonId)
end

function Camera.TransitionBack()
    if not Camera.isActive then return end

    Camera.isActive = false

    if DoesCamExist(Camera.handle) then
        RenderScriptCams(false, true, Config.Camera.transitionTime, true, true)
        DestroyCam(Camera.handle, false)
        Camera.handle = nil
    end

    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)

    Whip.core:SetScreenOpen(false, 'atm')

    ATM_DUI.HighlightButton(nil)

    Camera.targetATM = nil
    Camera.currentATMModel = nil
    Camera.atmCoords = nil
    Camera.atmHeadingQuat = nil
    Camera.cachedButtonCoords = {}
    Camera.initialRot = vec3(0, 0, 0)
    Camera.currentRot = vec3(0, 0, 0)

    TriggerEvent('atmdui:client:sessionEnded')
end

_G.ATM_Camera = Camera

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    if Camera.isActive then
        Camera.TransitionBack()
    end
end)

-- player's activity log. The move itself is the client's (it waits for the ground there, behind a fade).

local ACE = 'whip.devtools'
local LIMIT_XY, Z_MIN, Z_MAX = 10000.0, -200.0, 2700.0

local function say(src, text, kind) exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, text, kind or 'info') end
local function log(src, detail) CreateThread(function() Whip.core:LogActivity(src, 'teleport', { detail = detail }) end) end

-- "x y z h", "x, y, z", "vector3(x, y, z)", "vec4(...)": the numbers in what was typed
local function numbers(raw)
    local out = {}
    raw = raw:gsub('%a[%w_]*', ' ')   -- words first: the 4 of "vec4" is not a number typed
    for n in raw:gmatch('-?%d+%.?%d*') do out[#out + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    return out
end

Whip.command('tp', { ace = ACE, console = false }, function(src, args, raw)
    local typed = (raw or ''):gsub('^%S+%s*', '')   -- without "tp"
    local n = numbers(typed)

    -- /tp <server id>: to that player
    if #n == 1 and #args == 1 and math.type(n[1]) == 'integer' then
        local target = n[1]
        local ped = GetPlayerPed(target)
        if target == src then return say(src, 'That is you', 'error') end
        if not GetPlayerName(target) or not ped or ped == 0 then return say(src, ('No player with id %d'):format(target), 'error') end
        if GetPlayerRoutingBucket(target) ~= GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src) then
            return say(src, 'They are in another world (routing bucket): use /whip > Players instead', 'error')
        end
        local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        TriggerClientEvent('devtp:go', src, c.x, c.y, c.z, nil)
        log(src, ('to %s (%d)'):format(GetPlayerName(target), target))
        return
    end

    if #n < 2 then
        return say(src, 'Use /tp x y [z] [heading], or /tp <player id>', 'error')
    end
    local x, y, z, h = n[1], n[2], n[3], n[4]
    if math.abs(x) > LIMIT_XY or math.abs(y) > LIMIT_XY or (z and (z < Z_MIN or z > Z_MAX)) then
        return say(src, 'Those coordinates are off the map', 'error')
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('devtp:go', src, x + 0.0, y + 0.0, z and z + 0.0 or nil, h and h + 0.0 or nil)
    log(src, ('to %.1f, %.1f%s'):format(x, y, z and (', %.1f'):format(z) or ''))
end)

Whip.command('tpm', { ace = ACE, console = false }, function(src)
    TriggerClientEvent('devtp:marker', src)
    log(src, 'to their map waypoint')
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tracer collector. Writes what early.lua records in the traced resources (targets.json):
--   logs/<resource>/<YYYYMMDD>-server.log                    that resource's server side (all players)
--   logs/<resource>/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<id>-<name>.log         one player's game, one file per session
-- Server lines carry the server's GetGameTimer(); a player's lines carry his own, and each batch starts with
-- "#SYNC srv=<server timer at arrival> cli=<his timer when sent>" so both can be put on one timeline.
-- exports.<this resource>:switch() tells the tracers what to record (no answer while the tracer is stopped = nothing is
-- recorded anywhere); clients get it from a net event (no state bags: they need OneSync).
-- Known patterns: a tracer line ending in "\tp=<id>:ex" / ":eb" (an example of a pattern / of a big one) or
-- "\tp=<id>:nv" (a V line: new values) is written only if earlier sessions did not already write it: KNOWN_EX examples
-- per pattern in all (a big one: one, and only if there is none yet), each value once (KNOWN_NV values per pattern at
-- most). What was written is kept in logs/<resource>/known.tsv (across restarts); `tracer forget <resource|all>`
-- starts over (after an update of that resource, to get fresh examples).
-- Also installs the tracer into a resource (`tracer add`): copies early.lua there as tracer_early.lua and adds one
-- line to its manifest (docs in README.md).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local CFG = TracerConfig or {}
local LIM = CFG.limits or {}
local CMD = CFG.command or 'tracer'
local MB = 1024 * 1024
local EARLY = 'tracer_early.lua'

local MAX_FILE = (LIM.fileMB or 80) * MB
local MAX_RES = (LIM.resourceMB or 2048) * MB
local MAX_ALL = (LIM.totalMB or 5120) * MB
local MAX_PLAYER_MIN = (LIM.playerMBPerMinute or 30) * MB
local JOIN_GRACE_S = LIM.joinGraceSeconds or 180

local function say(msg) print(('[%s] %s'):format(RES, msg)) end

local mode = GetResourceKvpString('mode') or 'all' -- kept across restarts: `tracer off` stays off
if mode == 'list' then mode = 'players' end
local files = {}          -- [key] = { path, bytes, pend = {}, np, full }
local playerFile = {}     -- [res .. '|' .. src] = key
local resBytes, allBytes = {}, 0
local perMinute, dropped, pushes = {}, {}, 0
local firstPush = {}
local partial = {} -- [res .. '|' .. src] = the start of a line sent in pieces (client.lua: m = true)
local started = os.time()
local installState = {} -- [res] = 'ok' | 'outdated' | 'not installed' | ...

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- targets.json: ["resource", ...]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local TARGETS = {}
local function loadTargets()
    TARGETS = {}
    local ok, t = pcall(json.decode, LoadResourceFile(RES, 'targets.json') or '[]')
    if ok and type(t) == 'table' then
        for k, v in pairs(t) do
            local name = type(k) == 'number' and v or k -- also the older {"name": "path"} form
            if type(name) == 'string' and name ~= '' then TARGETS[name] = true end
        end
    end
end

local function targetList()
    local list = {}
    for name in pairs(TARGETS) do list[#list + 1] = name end
    table.sort(list)
    return list
end

local function saveTargets()
    local parts = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(targetList()) do parts[i] = '  ' .. json.encode(name) end
    local body = #parts > 0 and ('[\n' .. table.concat(parts, ',\n') .. '\n]\n') or '[]\n'
    return SaveResourceFile(RES, 'targets.json', body, -1)
end

-- folders inside this resource (fs.js: Lua can't create one)
local function mkdirp(rel)
    local ok, r = pcall(function() return exports[RES]:mkdirp(rel) end)
    if ok and r == 'ok' then return true end
    return false, ok and tostring(r) or tostring(r)
end

local function ensureLogDir(res)
    local ok, err = mkdirp('logs/' .. res)
    if not ok then say(('^3could not create logs/%s (%s): create that folder by hand^0'):format(res, err)) end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- known patterns
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local KNOWN_EX, KNOWN_NV = 3, 64
local known = {} -- [res] = { ex = {[id] = n}, nv = {[id \t path=value] = true}, nvn = {[id] = n}, new = {}, skipped = bytes }

local function knownPath(res) return ('@%s/logs/%s/known.tsv'):format(RES, res) end

local function knownOf(res)
    local k = known[res]
    if k then return k end
    k = { ex = {}, nv = {}, nvn = {}, new = {}, skipped = 0 }
    known[res] = k
    local fh = io.open(knownPath(res), 'r')
    if fh then
        for line in fh:lines() do
            local what, id, v = line:match('^(%a+)\t?(%x*)\t?(.*)$')
            if what == 'x' then
                k.ex[id] = (k.ex[id] or 0) + 1
            elseif what == 'X' then
                k.ex[id] = KNOWN_EX
            elseif what == 'v' then
                k.nv[id .. '\t' .. v] = true
                k.nvn[id] = (k.nvn[id] or 0) + 1
            elseif what == 'reset' then
                k.ex, k.nv, k.nvn = {}, {}, {}
            end
        end
        fh:close()
    end
    return k
end

local function split(s)
    local t, pos = {}, 1
    while true do
        local tab = s:find('\t', pos, true)
        if not tab then t[#t + 1] = s:sub(pos) return t end
        t[#t + 1] = s:sub(pos, tab - 1)
        pos = tab + 1
    end
end

-- the lines of patterns already written (this session or an earlier one) are dropped, and the values of a V line
-- already written are taken out of it; the tag becomes "\tp=<id>"
local function filter(res, chunk)
    if not chunk:find('\tp=', 1, true) then return chunk end
    local k = knownOf(res)
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for line in chunk:gmatch('[^\n]+') do
        local at = line:find("\tp=", math.max(1, #line - 40), true)
        local id, why
        if at then id, why = line:match('^\tp=(%x+):(%a%a)$', at) end
        local kept
        if not id then
            kept = line
        elseif why == 'ex' then
            local c = k.ex[id] or 0
            if c < KNOWN_EX then
                k.ex[id] = c + 1
                k.new[#k.new + 1] = 'x\t' .. id
                kept = line:sub(1, at - 1) .. '\tp=' .. id
            end
        elseif why == 'eb' then
            -- a big payload: one example in all
            if (k.ex[id] or 0) == 0 then
                k.ex[id] = KNOWN_EX
                k.new[#k.new + 1] = 'X\t' .. id
                kept = line:sub(1, at - 1) .. '\tp=' .. id
            end
        else
            -- <time> V <kind> <name> <path=value>...: only the values never written for this pattern stay
            local f = split(line:sub(1, at - 1))
            local vals = {}
            for i = 5, #f do
                local key = id .. '\t' .. f[i]
                if not k.nv[key] and (k.nvn[id] or 0) < KNOWN_NV then
                    k.nv[key] = true
                    k.nvn[id] = (k.nvn[id] or 0) + 1
                    k.new[#k.new + 1] = 'v\t' .. key
                    vals[#vals + 1] = f[i]
                end
            end
            if #vals > 0 and #f >= 4 then
                kept = table.concat(f, '\t', 1, 4) .. '\t' .. table.concat(vals, '\t') .. '\tp=' .. id
            end
        end
        if kept then
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = kept
        else
            k.skipped = k.skipped + #line + 1
        end
    end
    if n == 0 then return nil end
    return table.concat(out, '\n', 1, n)
end

local SWITCH = { mode = 'off', res = {}, pass = {} }
local watched = {} -- [player id] = true: traced in "players" mode

local function publish()
    local list, pass = {}, {}
    for name in pairs(TARGETS) do list[name] = true end
    for _, name in ipairs(CFG.passThrough or {}) do pass[name] = true end
    SWITCH = { mode = mode, res = list, pass = pass, quiet = (CFG.clientQuietSeconds or 120) * 1000 }
    TriggerClientEvent(RES .. ':switch', -1, SWITCH)
end

-- the server side of every traced resource asks this once a second
exports('switch', function() return SWITCH end)

-- a player's client half asks once when it starts (then gets every change)
local hello = {}
RegisterNetEvent(RES .. ':hello', function()
    local src = source
    if hello[src] and os.time() - hello[src] < 5 then return end
    hello[src] = os.time()
    TriggerClientEvent(RES .. ':switch', src, SWITCH)
    if watched[src] then TriggerClientEvent(RES .. ':watch', src, true) end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- files
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function fileFor(key, path)
    local f = files[key]
    if not f then
        f = { path = path, base = path:sub(1, -5), part = 1, bytes = 0, pend = {}, np = 0 }
        files[key] = f
    end
    return f
end

local function add(f, res, text)
    if f.full then return end
    local n = #text + 1
    if f.bytes + n > MAX_FILE and (resBytes[res] or 0) + n <= MAX_RES and allBytes + n <= MAX_ALL then
        f.part = f.part + 1
        f.path = ('%s.p%d.log'):format(f.base, f.part)
        f.bytes = 0
    end
    if (resBytes[res] or 0) + n > MAX_RES or allBytes + n > MAX_ALL then
        f.full = true
        f.np = f.np + 1
        f.pend[f.np] = '#FULL ' .. os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') .. ' (size limit reached: nothing more in this file)'
        if allBytes + n > MAX_ALL and mode ~= 'off' then
            mode = 'off'
            publish()
            say(('^1%d MB written: tracing switched off (limits.totalMB in config.lua)^0'):format(MAX_ALL // MB))
        end
        return
    end
    f.bytes = f.bytes + n
    resBytes[res] = (resBytes[res] or 0) + n
    allBytes = allBytes + n
    f.np = f.np + 1
    f.pend[f.np] = text
end

local function serverFile(res)
    local day = os.date('%Y%m%d')
    return fileFor(res .. '|srv|' .. day, ('@%s/logs/%s/%s-server.log'):format(RES, res, day))
end

-- FNV-1a: the same player gets the same short hash, the license itself is not kept
local function fnv32(s)
    local h = 0x811c9dc5
    for i = 1, #s do h = ((h ~ s:byte(i)) * 0x01000193) & 0xffffffff end
    return ('%08x'):format(h)
end

local function playerIdentifier(src)
    local how = CFG.playerIdentifier or 'hash'
    if how == 'none' then return '-' end
    local lic = GetPlayerIdentifierByType and GetPlayerIdentifierByType(src, 'license') or nil
    if not lic then
        for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayerIdentifiers(src) or {}) do
            if id:sub(1, 8) == 'license:' then lic = id break end
        end
    end
    if not lic then return '?' end
    if how == 'license' then return lic end
    return 'hash:' .. fnv32(lic) .. fnv32(lic .. '#')
end

local function playerFileOf(res, src)
    local k = res .. '|' .. src
    local key = playerFile[k]
    if not key then
        key = k .. '|' .. os.time()
        playerFile[k] = key
        local name = tostring(GetPlayerName(src) or '?')
        local suffix = CFG.playerNameInFileName == false and '' or ('-' .. name:gsub('[^%w_-]', '_'):sub(1, 24))
        local f = fileFor(key, ('@%s/logs/%s/%s-%s%s.log'):format(RES, res, os.date('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'), src, suffix))
        add(f, res, ('#PLAYER id=%s name=%s id2=%s started=%s'):format(src, (name:gsub('[%c\t]', ' ')), playerIdentifier(src),
            os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')))
    end
    return files[key]
end

-- a traced resource's server side (local event: never from the network)
AddEventHandler(RES .. ':s', function(res, t, chunk)
    if type(res) ~= 'string' or type(chunk) ~= 'string' or not TARGETS[res] then return end
    if GetInvokingResource() ~= res then return end
    chunk = filter(res, chunk)
    if chunk then add(serverFile(res), res, chunk) end
end)

-- a player's game (client.lua batches every traced resource)
RegisterNetEvent(RES .. ':push', function(list, cliNow)
    local src = source
    if mode == 'off' or type(list) ~= 'table' or #list > 2000 then return end
    firstPush[src] = firstPush[src] or os.time()
    local grace = os.time() - firstPush[src] < JOIN_GRACE_S
    local minute = os.time() // 60
    local pm = perMinute[src]
    if not pm or pm.m ~= minute then
        pm = { m = minute, b = 0 }
        perMinute[src] = pm
    end
    pushes = pushes + 1
    local srvNow = GetGameTimer()
    for i = 1, #list do
        local e = list[i]
        local res, chunk = type(e) == 'table' and e.r, type(e) == 'table' and e.c
        if type(res) == 'string' and TARGETS[res] and type(chunk) == 'string' then
            pm.b = pm.b + #chunk
            if pm.b > MAX_PLAYER_MIN and not grace then
                dropped[src] = (dropped[src] or 0) + #chunk
            else
                local pk = res .. '|' .. src
                if e.m then
                    partial[pk] = (partial[pk] or '') .. chunk
                    if #partial[pk] > 4 * MB then partial[pk] = nil end -- never ends: dropped
                else
                    if partial[pk] then
                        chunk = partial[pk] .. chunk
                        partial[pk] = nil
                    end
                    chunk = filter(res, chunk)
                    if chunk then
                        local f = playerFileOf(res, src)
                        add(f, res, ('#SYNC\tsrv=%d\tcli=%s\tsent=%s'):format(srvNow, tostring(e.t), tostring(cliNow)))
                        add(f, res, chunk)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function(reason)
    local src = source
    for res in pairs(TARGETS) do
        local key = playerFile[res .. '|' .. src]
        if key and files[key] then
            add(files[key], res, ('#DROPPED %s %s'):format(os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), tostring(reason)))
        end
        playerFile[res .. '|' .. src] = nil
        partial[res .. '|' .. src] = nil
    end
    perMinute[src] = nil
    firstPush[src] = nil
    hello[src] = nil
    watched[src] = nil
end)

-- writes, spread over ticks: open, append, close (keeps no handle open)
local function flush(spread)
    for res, k in pairs(known) do
        if #k.new > 0 then
            local fh = io.open(knownPath(res), 'a')
            if fh then
                fh:write(table.concat(k.new, '\n'), '\n')
                fh:close()
            end
            k.new = {}
        end
    end
    local n = 0
    for key, f in pairs(files) do
        if f.np > 0 then
            local fh = io.open(f.path, 'a')
            if fh then
                fh:write(table.concat(f.pend, '\n', 1, f.np), '\n')
                fh:close()
            elseif not f.warned then
                f.warned = true
                say('^3cannot write ' .. f.path:sub(#RES + 3) .. ' (does its folder exist?)^0')
            end
            f.pend, f.np = {}, 0
            n = n + 1
            if spread and n % 20 == 0 then Wait(0) end
        end
        -- a finished player session / an old day: forgotten once written
        if f.np == 0 and not key:find('|srv|', 1, true) then
            local res, src = key:match('^(.-)|(%d+)|')
            if res and playerFile[res .. '|' .. src] ~= key then files[key] = nil end
        elseif f.np == 0 and key:find('|srv|', 1, true) and not key:find(os.date('%Y%m%d'), 1, true) then
            files[key] = nil
        end
    end
end

    while true do
        Wait(3000)
        local ok, err = pcall(flush, true)
        if not ok then say('flush error: ' .. tostring(err)) end
    end
end)

-- installing the tracer into a resource: <res>/tracer_early.lua + one manifest line
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installer = {}
local SCRIPT_KEYS = { shared_script = true, shared_scripts = true, client_script = true, client_scripts = true,
    server_script = true, server_scripts = true }

local function lines(text)
    local nl = text:find('\r\n', 1, true) and '\r\n' or '\n'
    local t, pos = {}, 1
    while true do
        local a = text:find(nl, pos, true)
        if not a then t[#t + 1] = text:sub(pos) break end
        t[#t + 1] = text:sub(pos, a - 1)
        pos = a + #nl
    end
    return t, nl
end

-- the manifest with our line(s) before its first script declaration (line endings kept); nil + why when it can't
function Installer.insert(text, res, legacy)
    if text:find(EARLY, 1, true) then return text, 'already' end
    local t, nl = lines(text)
    local at, comment = nil, false
    for i, l in ipairs(t) do
        if comment then
            if l:find(']]', 1, true) then comment = false end
        elseif l:match('^%s*%-%-%[=*%[') and not l:find(']]', 1, true) then
            comment = true
        else
            local key = l:match('^%s*([%a_]+)')
            if key and SCRIPT_KEYS[key] then at = i break end
        end
    end
    if not at then return nil, 'no script in its manifest: nothing to trace' end
    local note = ('-- tracer: traces this resource (`%s remove %s` takes it out)'):format(CMD, res)
    if legacy then
        -- __resource.lua: shared_script may not exist there
        table.insert(t, at, ("server_script '%s' %s"):format(EARLY, note))
        table.insert(t, at, ("client_script '%s' %s"):format(EARLY, note))
    else
        table.insert(t, at, ("shared_script '%s' %s"):format(EARLY, note))
    end
    return table.concat(t, nl)
end

-- the manifest without our lines, and how many were taken out
function Installer.remove(text)
    local t, nl = lines(text)
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for _, l in ipairs(t) do
        if l:find(EARLY, 1, true) then n = n + 1 else out[#out + 1] = l end
    end
    return table.concat(out, nl), n
end

-- early.lua with this resource's name written in (the tracer finds its collector by it)
function Installer.stamp(code, name)
    local repl = ("local COLLECTOR = '%s' --@collector"):format(name):gsub('%%', '%%%%')
    local out, n = code:gsub("local COLLECTOR = '[^'\r\n]*' %-%-@collector", repl, 1)
    if n ~= 1 then return nil end
    return out
end

function Installer.versionOf(code)
    return type(code) == 'string' and code:match("local TRACER_VERSION = '([^']+)'") or nil
end

local function manifestOf(res)
    for _, m in ipairs({ 'fxmanifest.lua', '__resource.lua' }) do
        local t = LoadResourceFile(res, m)
        if t then return m, t end
    end
end

local function stampedEarly()
    local code = LoadResourceFile(RES, 'early.lua')
    return code and Installer.stamp(code, RES)
end

-- 'ok', 'outdated' (another version or collector name), 'manifest' (copy there, line gone: a vendor update
-- replaced the manifest), 'not installed'
local function checkInstall(res)
    local copy = LoadResourceFile(res, EARLY)
    local _, mtext = manifestOf(res)
    local inManifest = mtext and mtext:find(EARLY, 1, true) ~= nil
    if not copy then return 'not installed' end
    if not inManifest then return 'manifest' end
    local mine = stampedEarly()
    if mine and copy ~= mine then return 'outdated' end
    return 'ok'
end

local function permissionHelp(res, what)
    say(('^1FXServer does not let %s write into %s.^0 Either:'):format(RES, res))
    say(('  - add this line to server.cfg (before the ensure lines), restart the server, then `%s %s %s` again:'):format(CMD, what, res))
    say(('        add_filesystem_permission %s write %s'):format(RES, res))
    say(('  - or, on the machine:  python3 "%s/tools/install.py" %s "%s"'):format(GetResourcePath(RES), what, GetResourcePath(res) or res))
end

local function restartAdvice(res)
    say(('  next: `refresh` then `restart %s`. A resource that streams assets (maps, vehicles, clothes, a stream/'):format(res))
    say('  folder): restart the whole server instead, a live restart of streamed assets can crash players.')
end

local function cmdAdd(res)
    if type(res) ~= 'string' or not res:match('^[%w_%.%-]+$') then return say('usage: ' .. CMD .. ' add <resource>') end
    if res == RES then return say('the tracer does not trace itself') end
    if GetResourceState(res) == 'missing' then return say(res .. ': no such resource (`refresh` if it was just added)') end
    local mname, text = manifestOf(res)
    if not mname then return say(res .. ': no fxmanifest.lua or __resource.lua') end
    local newText, why = Installer.insert(text, res, mname == '__resource.lua')
    if not newText then return say(res .. ': ' .. why) end
    local code = stampedEarly()
    if not code then return say('early.lua is missing or changed in ' .. RES .. ': reinstall the tracer') end
    -- the tracer file first: its write tells whether FXServer lets this resource write there
    if not SaveResourceFile(res, EARLY, code, -1) then return permissionHelp(res, 'add') end
    mkdirp('backups')
    local backup = ('backups/%s.%s'):format(res, mname)
    if not LoadResourceFile(RES, backup) then SaveResourceFile(RES, backup, text, -1) end
    if why ~= 'already' and not SaveResourceFile(res, mname, newText, -1) then return permissionHelp(res, 'add') end
    TARGETS[res] = true
    saveTargets()
    ensureLogDir(res)
    installState[res] = 'ok'
    publish()
    say(('%s: %s (manifest backup in %s/%s)'):format(res, why == 'already' and 'already traced, tracer file refreshed'
        or ('tracer added to its ' .. mname), RES, backup))
    restartAdvice(res)
end

local function cmdRemove(res)
    if type(res) ~= 'string' or not res:match('^[%w_%.%-]+$') then return say('usage: ' .. CMD .. ' remove <resource>') end
    local mname, text = manifestOf(res)
    if text and text:find(EARLY, 1, true) then
        local newText = Installer.remove(text)
        if not SaveResourceFile(res, mname, newText, -1) then return permissionHelp(res, 'remove') end
    end
    local path = GetResourcePath(res)
    if path and LoadResourceFile(res, EARLY) then pcall(os.remove, path .. '/' .. EARLY) end
    local left = LoadResourceFile(res, EARLY) ~= nil
    local was = TARGETS[res]
    TARGETS[res] = nil
    installState[res] = nil
    saveTargets()
    publish()
    say(('%s: %s%s'):format(res, was and 'not traced any more' or 'was not in targets.json',
        left and (' (delete ' .. EARLY .. ' from its folder: it is no longer loaded)') or ''))
    say(('  its logs stay in %s/logs/%s. It stops writing now; the tracer file stays loaded until `restart %s`.'):format(RES, res, res))
end

local function cmdUpdate()
    local code = stampedEarly()
    if not code then return say('early.lua is missing or changed in ' .. RES) end
    for _, res in ipairs(targetList()) do
        local st = checkInstall(res)
        if st == 'outdated' then
            if SaveResourceFile(res, EARLY, code, -1) then
                installState[res] = 'ok'
                say(res .. ': tracer file updated (live at its next restart)')
            else
                permissionHelp(res, 'add')
            end
        else
            say(('%s: %s'):format(res, st == 'ok' and 'up to date' or (st .. ': `' .. CMD .. ' add ' .. res .. '`')))
        end
    end
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(name)
    if name ~= RES then return end
    loadTargets()
    mkdirp('backups')
    local bad = 0
    for _, res in ipairs(targetList()) do
        ensureLogDir(res)
        local st = checkInstall(res)
        installState[res] = st
        if st ~= 'ok' then
            bad = bad + 1
            local hint = st == 'outdated' and ('older tracer file: `' .. CMD .. ' update`')
                or st == 'manifest' and ('its manifest lost the tracer line (an update?): `' .. CMD .. ' add ' .. res .. '`')
                or ('`' .. CMD .. ' add ' .. res .. '`')
            say(('^3%s: %s^0'):format(res, hint))
        end
    end
    publish()
    say(('tracing %d resource(s), mode %s (`%s` for status)'):format(#targetList(), mode, CMD))
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name)
    if name ~= RES then return end
    pcall(flush, false)
end)

local function mb(b) return b < MB and ('%.1f KB'):format(b / 1024) or ('%.1f MB'):format(b / MB) end

local HELP = {
    'status                 what is traced, MB written / avoided, players',
    'on | off               trace everyone / nothing (kept after a restart)',
    'players                trace only the players chosen with watch (server sides always traced)',
    'watch <id> | unwatch <id>',
    'add <resource>         install the tracer into a resource and trace it',
    'remove <resource>      take it out again',
    'update                 copy a newer early.lua into every traced resource',
    'reload                 read targets.json again (after tools/install.py)',
    'mark <text>            a marker line in every log (find a test again)',
    'flush                  write what is waiting now',
    'forget <resource|all>  forget the known patterns: examples are written again',
}

RegisterCommand(CMD, function(src, args)
    if src ~= 0 then return end -- server console / txAdmin live console only
    local cmd = args[1] or 'status'
    if cmd == 'on' or cmd == 'all' then
        mode = 'all'
    elseif cmd == 'off' or cmd == 'players' then
        mode = cmd
    elseif cmd == 'watch' or cmd == 'unwatch' then
        local id = tonumber(args[2])
        if not id or not GetPlayerName(id) then return say('no such player') end
        watched[id] = cmd == 'watch' or nil
        TriggerClientEvent(RES .. ':watch', id, cmd == 'watch')
        return say(('%s %s (only matters in "players" mode)'):format(cmd == 'watch' and 'tracing' or 'not tracing', GetPlayerName(id)))
    elseif cmd == 'add' then
        return cmdAdd(args[2])
    elseif cmd == 'remove' or cmd == 'del' then
        return cmdRemove(args[2])
    elseif cmd == 'update' then
        return cmdUpdate()
    elseif cmd == 'reload' then
        loadTargets()
        for _, res in ipairs(targetList()) do
            ensureLogDir(res)
            installState[res] = checkInstall(res)
        end
        publish()
        return say(('targets.json read again: %d resource(s)'):format(#targetList()))
    elseif cmd == 'mark' then
        local text = table.concat(args, ' ', 2)
        local line = ('#MARK\t%s\tsrv=%d\t%s'):format(os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), GetGameTimer(), text)
        for key, f in pairs(files) do
            local res = key:match('^(.-)|')
            if res then add(f, res, line) end
        end
        TriggerEvent(RES .. ':mark', 'console: ' .. text)
        TriggerClientEvent(RES .. ':netmark', -1, 'console: ' .. text)
        return say('mark written')
    elseif cmd == 'flush' then
        flush(false)
        return say('flushed')
    elseif cmd == 'forget' then
        local which = args[2]
        local done = {}
        for res in pairs(TARGETS) do
            if which == 'all' or which == res then
                local fh = io.open(knownPath(res), 'a')
                if fh then
                    fh:write('reset\t', os.date('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'), '\n')
                    fh:close()
                end
                known[res] = { ex = {}, nv = {}, nvn = {}, new = {}, skipped = 0 }
                done[#done + 1] = res
            end
        end
        if #done == 0 then return say(CMD .. ' forget <resource|all>') end
        return say('known patterns forgotten (examples written again): ' .. table.concat(done, ', '))
    elseif cmd ~= 'status' then
        say('usage: ' .. CMD .. ' <command>')
        for _, h in ipairs(HELP) do print('  ' .. h) end
        return
    end
    if cmd ~= 'status' then
        SetResourceKvp('mode', mode)
        publish()
        say('mode: ' .. mode)
        return
    end
    say(('mode %s, running %d min, %s written (limit %s), %d pushes'):format(mode, (os.time() - started) // 60,
        mb(allBytes), mb(MAX_ALL), pushes))
    for _, name in ipairs(targetList()) do
        local players = 0
        for k in pairs(playerFile) do if k:sub(1, #name + 1) == name .. '|' then players = players + 1 end end
        print(('  %-32s %10s  known (not written): %10s  players now: %d  resource: %s  tracer: %s'):format(name,
            mb(resBytes[name] or 0), mb(known[name] and known[name].skipped or 0), players, GetResourceState(name),
            installState[name] or '?'))
    end
    if #targetList() == 0 then print(('  nothing traced yet: `%s add <resource>`'):format(CMD)) end
    local d = 0
    for _, b in pairs(dropped) do d = d + b end
    if d > 0 then print('  dropped (players over ' .. mb(MAX_PLAYER_MIN) .. '/min): ' .. mb(d)) end
end, true)

local _print = print
local print = function(...)
    if Config.Debug then _print(...) end
end

local DUI = {}
DUI.duiObject = nil
DUI.duiHandle = nil
DUI.txdName = nil
DUI.texName = nil
DUI.isActive = false
DUI.appliedTexture = nil
DUI.currentTextureIdx = 1

local TextureCandidates = {
    ['prop_atm_01'] = {
        { dict = 'prop_atm_01', name = 'prop_cashpoint_screen' },
        { dict = 'prop_atm_01', name = 'prop_cashpoint_01' },
    },
    ['prop_atm_02'] = {
        { dict = 'prop_atm_02', name = 'prop_cashpoint_screen' },
        { dict = 'prop_atm_02', name = 'prop_cashpoint_02b' },
    },
    ['prop_atm_03'] = {
        { dict = 'prop_atm_03', name = 'prop_cashpoint_screen' },
        { dict = 'prop_atm_03', name = 'prop_cashpoint_02b' },
    },
    ['prop_fleeca_atm'] = {
        { dict = 'prop_fleeca_atm', name = 'prop_fleece_emis' },
        { dict = 'prop_fleeca_atm', name = 'prop_fleece_atm' },
    },
}

DUI.currentModel = nil

function DUI.Create()
    if DUI.duiObject then return end

    local url = ('nui://%s/html/index.html?dui=true'):format(GetCurrentResourceName())
    local width = Config.DUI.width or 512
    local height = Config.DUI.height or 512

    print('^3[atm-dui] Creating DUI with URL: ' .. url .. '^0')

    DUI.duiObject = CreateDui(url, width, height)

    if not DUI.duiObject then
        print('^1[atm-dui] Failed to create DUI object!^0')
        return false
    end

    DUI.duiHandle = GetDuiHandle(DUI.duiObject)

    DUI.txdName = 'atm_dui_txd'
    DUI.texName = 'atm_dui_tex'

    local txd = CreateRuntimeTxd(DUI.txdName)

    Wait(250)

    CreateRuntimeTextureFromDuiHandle(txd, DUI.texName, DUI.duiHandle)

    print('^2[atm-dui] DUI created successfully^0')
    print('^2[atm-dui] TXD: ' .. DUI.txdName .. ', TEX: ' .. DUI.texName .. '^0')

    Wait(500)

    return true
end

function DUI.ApplyTexture(atmModel)
    if not DUI.duiObject then
        if not DUI.Create() then
            return false
        end
    end

    local modelName = nil
    for _, model in ipairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(model) == atmModel then
            modelName = model
            break
        end
    end

    if not modelName then
        print('^1[atm-dui] Unknown ATM model: ' .. atmModel .. '^0')
        return false
    end

    local candidates = TextureCandidates[modelName]
    if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then
        print('^1[atm-dui] No texture candidates for: ' .. modelName .. '^0')
        return false
    end

    DUI.currentModel = modelName

    DUI.SendMessage('SET_MODEL', { model = modelName, rows = DUI.RowsFor(modelName) })

    local candidate = candidates[DUI.currentTextureIdx]
    if not candidate then
        DUI.currentTextureIdx = 1
        candidate = candidates[1]
    end

    print('^3[atm-dui] Applying texture replacement: ' .. candidate.dict .. '/' .. candidate.name .. ' (candidate ' .. DUI.currentTextureIdx .. '/' .. #candidates .. ')^0')

    if DUI.appliedTexture then
        RemoveReplaceTexture(DUI.appliedTexture.dict, DUI.appliedTexture.name)
    end

    AddReplaceTexture(candidate.dict, candidate.name, DUI.txdName, DUI.texName)
    DUI.appliedTexture = candidate
    DUI.isActive = true

    return true
end

function DUI.RowsFor(modelName)
    local rows = Config.ScreenRows or {}
    return rows[modelName] or rows.default
end

local calibrating = false
RegisterCommand('atmrows', function(_, args)
    if not exports.whip_core:HasDevTools() then return end
    if not DUI.currentModel then
        print('[atmdui] use an ATM first (atmrows works while you are at its keypad)')
        return
    end
    local side = args[1]
    if side == 'left' or side == 'right' then
        local rows = DUI.RowsFor(DUI.currentModel)
        local copy = { left = { table.unpack(rows.left) }, right = { table.unpack(rows.right) } }
        for i = 1, 4 do copy[side][i] = tonumber(args[i + 1]) or copy[side][i] end
        Config.ScreenRows[DUI.currentModel] = copy
        DUI.SendMessage('SET_ROWS', { rows = copy })
        print(("[atmdui] Config.ScreenRows: ['%s'] = { left = { %s }, right = { %s } },"):format(DUI.currentModel,
            table.concat(copy.left, ', '), table.concat(copy.right, ', ')))
        return
    end
    calibrating = not calibrating
    DUI.SendMessage('CALIBRATE', { on = calibrating })
    print('[atmdui] calibration ' .. (calibrating and 'on' or 'off') .. ' for ' .. DUI.currentModel)
end, false)

function DUI.RemoveTexture()
    if not DUI.isActive or not DUI.appliedTexture then return end

    RemoveReplaceTexture(DUI.appliedTexture.dict, DUI.appliedTexture.name)
    DUI.appliedTexture = nil
    DUI.isActive = false
    DUI.currentModel = nil
end

function DUI.SendMessage(action, data)
    if not DUI.duiObject then return end

    local message = json.encode({
        action = action,
        data = data
    })

    SendDuiMessage(DUI.duiObject, message)
end

function DUI.SetScreen(screen, data)
    DUI.SendMessage('SET_SCREEN', {
        screen = screen,
        data = data or {}
    })
end

function DUI.ShowNotification(message, type)
    DUI.SendMessage('NOTIFICATION', {
        message = message,
        type = type or 'info'
    })
end

function DUI.SetProcessing(isProcessing, duration)
    DUI.SendMessage('SET_PROCESSING', { processing = isProcessing, duration = duration })
end

function DUI.HighlightButton(buttonId)
    DUI.SendMessage('HIGHLIGHT_BUTTON', { buttonId = buttonId })
end

function DUI.ClickButton(buttonId)
    DUI.SendMessage('CLICK_BUTTON', { buttonId = buttonId })
end

function DUI.InitSession(playerData)
    DUI.SendMessage('INIT_SESSION', {
        playerName = playerData.name,
        bankBalance = playerData.bank,
        bankName = Config.UI.bankName,
        quickAmounts = Config.Transactions.quickAmounts,
        maxWithdraw = Config.Transactions.maxWithdraw,
        maxDeposit = Config.Transactions.maxDeposit,
        locale = Config.Locales[Config.UI.language] or Config.Locales['en'],
        language = Config.Locales[Config.UI.language] and Config.UI.language or 'en',
    })
end

function DUI.EndSession()
    DUI.SendMessage('END_SESSION', {})
    DUI.SetScreen('welcome')
end

function DUI.Destroy()
    DUI.RemoveTexture()
    if DUI.duiObject then
        DestroyDui(DUI.duiObject)
        DUI.duiObject = nil
        DUI.duiHandle = nil
    end
    DUI.isActive = false
end

_G.ATM_DUI = DUI

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    DUI.Destroy()
end)

-- fake FiveM runtime for the tracer's early.lua (Lua 5.4). One call of stub.new() = one resource runtime.
local M = {}

local VMT = {}
VMT.__index = VMT
local function vec(x, y, z) return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y, z = z }, VMT) end
VMT.__sub = function(a, b) return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z) end
VMT.__len = function(a) return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y + a.z * a.z) end
M.vec = vec

-- natives come from a chunk whose name looks like FiveM's natives file (isNative() checks the source)
local NATSRC = [[
local S = ...
local N = {}
function N.GetEntityCoords(e) return S.pos end
function N.GetEntityHeading(e) return S.heading end
function N.PlayerPedId() return 1001 end
function N.PlayerId() return 0 end
function N.GetPlayerServerId() return 7 end
function N.GetVehiclePedIsIn() return 0 end
function N.GetEntityModel() return 123 end
function N.IsScreenFadedOut() return false end
function N.IsScreenFadingOut() return false end
function N.IsScreenFadingIn() return false end
function N.GetRenderingCam() return S.cam end
function N.GetFinalRenderedCamCoord() return S.pos end
function N.GetFinalRenderedCamRot() return S.pos end
function N.GetFinalRenderedCamFov() return 50.0 end
function N.IsNuiFocused() return S.nui end
function N.GetInteriorFromEntity() return 0 end
function N.IsEntityVisible() return true end
function N.IsEntityPositionFrozen() return false end
function N.IsPauseMenuActive() return false end
function N.DoesEntityExist() return true end
function N.GetEntityRotation() return S.pos end
function N.IsEntityAttached() return false end
function N.GetEntityAttachedTo() return 0 end
function N.GetEntityAlpha() return 255 end
function N.GetFrameCount() return 1 end
function N.GetResourceState(r) return S.states[r] or 'missing' end
function N.GetResourceMetadata() return '1.0' end
function N.GetInvokingResource() return S.invoking end
function N.SetVehicleHandlingFloat(veh, cls, field, v) S.handling[field] = v end
function N.IsEntityDead(e) return S.dead end
function N.SetNuiFocus(a, b) S.nui = a end
function N.CreateCam(name) return 77 end
function N.DestroyCam(c) end
function N.GetStreetNameAtCoord(x, y, z) return 1376516937, 0 end
function N.SendNuiMessage(s) S.nuiSent[#S.nuiSent + 1] = s end
return N
]]

function M.new(opts)
    local S = { pos = vec(0, 0, 0), heading = 0.0, cam = -1, nui = false, states = {}, handling = {}, dead = false,
        nuiSent = {}, lines = {}, handlers = {}, threads = {}, clock = 1000, nuiMsgs = {}, invoking = opts.invoking }
    local SERVER = opts.server
    local RES = opts.res or 'test'
    S.collector = opts.collector or 'tracer'
    local NAT = load(NATSRC, '@citizen:/scripting/lua/natives_universal.lua')(S)

    local env = {}
    for k, v in pairs(_G) do env[k] = v end
    env._G = env
    env.print = function() end -- the resource's prints: silent
    env.GetGameTimer = function() return S.clock end
    env.IsDuplicityVersion = function() return SERVER end
    env.GetCurrentResourceName = function() return RES end
    local function dispatch(ev, ...)
        if ev == S.collector .. ':c' or ev == S.collector .. ':s' then
            local _, _, chunk = ...
            for line in chunk:gmatch('[^\n]+') do S.lines[#S.lines + 1] = line end
            S.chunks = (S.chunks or 0) + 1
            S.lastChunk = chunk
            return
        end
        for _, h in ipairs(S.handlers[ev] or {}) do h(...) end
    end
    S.dispatch = dispatch
    env.TriggerEvent = dispatch
    env.AddEventHandler = function(ev, fn) S.handlers[ev] = S.handlers[ev] or {} table.insert(S.handlers[ev], fn) return { ev, fn } end
    env.RegisterNetEvent = function(ev, fn) if fn then return env.AddEventHandler(ev, fn) end end
    env.TriggerServerEvent = function(ev, ...) S.sent = (S.sent or 0) + 1 end
    env.TriggerLatentServerEvent = function() end
    env.TriggerClientEvent = function(ev, target, ...) S.tc = (S.tc or 0) + 1 end
    env.TriggerLatentClientEvent = function() end
    env.RegisterNUICallback = function(name, fn) S.nuiCb = S.nuiCb or {} S.nuiCb[name] = fn end
    env.SendNUIMessage = function(t) S.nuiMsgs[#S.nuiMsgs + 1] = t end
    env.RegisterCommand = function(name, fn) S.cmds = S.cmds or {} S.cmds[name] = fn end
    env.AddStateBagChangeHandler = function(key, bag, fn) S.sbc = fn end
    -- what the collector's switch export answers (tests change S.switch)
    S.switch = { mode = 'all', res = { [RES] = true } }
    S.states[S.collector] = 'started'
    env.GlobalState = {}
    env.LocalPlayer = { state = {} }
    env.json = opts.json
    env.msgpack = { unpack = function(v) return v end }
    S.rows = { { id = 1, name = 'bread' } }
    S.esxCbs = {}
    local RESOURCES = {
        [S.collector] = { switch = function(self) return S.switch end },
        -- oxmysql: callback style, (query, cb), _async; awaitConnection counts its arguments
        oxmysql = {
            query = function(self, q, p, cb, ...)
                S.sqlCalls = (S.sqlCalls or 0) + 1
                if type(p) == 'function' then p(S.rows) elseif cb then cb(S.rows) end
            end,
            query_async = function(self, q, p) S.sqlCalls = (S.sqlCalls or 0) + 1 return S.rows end,
            awaitConnection = function(self, ...) S.awaitArgs = select('#', ...) return true end,
        },
        es_extended = {
            getSharedObject = function(self)
                S.esx = S.esx or { RegisterServerCallback = function(name, fn) S.esxCbs[name] = fn end,
                    GetPlayerFromId = function(id) return { getName = function() return 'Tester' end } end }
                return S.esx
            end,
        },
    }
    env.exports = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, res)
            if RESOURCES[res] then return RESOURCES[res] end
            return setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, fn) return function(self, ...) S.exportCalls = (S.exportCalls or 0) + 1 return ... end end })
        end,
        __call = function(_, name, fn) S.exports = S.exports or {} S.exports[name] = fn end,
    })
    env.Citizen = {
        CreateThread = function(fn) table.insert(S.threads, { co = coroutine.create(fn), wake = 0 }) end,
        Wait = function(ms) coroutine.yield(ms or 0) end,
        Trace = function() end,
        InvokeNative = function(h, ...) return 0 end,
        LoadNative = function(n) return NAT[n] ~= nil end,
    }
    if SERVER then
        for k, v in pairs(NAT) do env[k] = v end
    else
        -- client: natives load on first use (FiveM's natives_loader.lua is _G's __index)
        setmetatable(env, { __index = function(t, k) return NAT[k] end })
        env.GetEntityCoords, env.GetResourceState, env.GetInvokingResource = nil, nil, nil
    end
    -- the scheduler's own copies (taken by early.lua before it wraps anything)
    env.GetResourceState = env.GetResourceState or NAT.GetResourceState
    env.GetInvokingResource = NAT.GetInvokingResource
    env.GetResourceMetadata = NAT.GetResourceMetadata
    S.env, S.NAT = env, NAT

    function S.load(path, chunkname)
        local f = assert(io.open(path)):read('a')
        local fn = assert(load(f, chunkname, 't', env))
        return fn()
    end
    function S.code(src, chunkname)
        local fn = assert(load(src, chunkname or ('@@' .. RES .. '/client.lua'), 't', env))
        return fn()
    end
    function S.run(ms)
        local stop = S.clock + ms
        while S.clock < stop do
            S.clock = S.clock + 50
            for _, th in ipairs(S.threads) do
                if coroutine.status(th.co) ~= 'dead' and th.wake <= S.clock then
                    local ok, w = coroutine.resume(th.co)
                    if not ok then error('thread: ' .. tostring(w)) end
                    th.wake = S.clock + (tonumber(w) or 0)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function S.count(pat, plain)
        local n = 0
        for _, l in ipairs(S.lines) do if l:find(pat, 1, plain) then n = n + 1 end end
        return n
    end
    function S.grep(pat, plain)
        local r = {}
        for _, l in ipairs(S.lines) do if l:find(pat, 1, plain) then r[#r + 1] = l end end
        return r
    end
    function S.bytes()
        local b = 0
        for _, l in ipairs(S.lines) do b = b + #l + 1 end
        return b
    end
    return S
end

return M

local function loadModel(model)
    if HasModelLoaded(model) then return true end
    RequestModel(model)
    local untilAt = GetGameTimer() + 2500
    while not HasModelLoaded(model) and GetGameTimer() < untilAt do Wait(10) end
    return HasModelLoaded(model)
end

local function loadDict(dict)
    if HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) then return true end
    RequestAnimDict(dict)
    local untilAt = GetGameTimer() + 2500
    while not HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) and GetGameTimer() < untilAt do Wait(10) end
    return HasAnimDictLoaded(dict)
end

local duiMade = false
Whip.register(function()
    if not duiMade then
        duiMade = true
        CreateThread(function() ATM_DUI.Create() end)
    end
    ATM.SetupInteraction()
end)

function ATM.SetupInteraction()
    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id = 'atm',
        at = {
            model = Config.ATMModels,
            offset = Config.Interaction.offset,
            heading = Config.Interaction.heading,
            perModel = Config.Interaction.perModel,
        },
        label = Locale('use_atm'),
        icon = 'cash',
        reach = Config.Interaction.reach,
        canInteract = function() return not ATM.inSession end,
        onSelect = function(ctx)
            ATM.StartSession(ctx.entity)
        end,
    })
end

function ATM.DispenseCash(amount)
    print("^3[ATM DEBUG] Triggering DispenseCash for amount:^0", amount)
    if not ATM.currentATM or not DoesEntityExist(ATM.currentATM) then
        print("^1[ATM DEBUG] currentATM does not exist!^0")
        return
    end

    local model = `prop_anim_cash_pile_01`
    if amount > 500 then
        model = `prop_cash_pile_02`
    end

    print("^3[ATM DEBUG] Requesting model:^0", model)
    loadModel(model)
    if not HasModelLoaded(model) then
        print("^1[ATM DEBUG] Failed to load cash model!^0")
        return
    end

    local atmObj = ATM.currentATM
    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmObj)

    local modelHash = GetEntityModel(atmObj)
    local configKey
    for _, v in pairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(v) == modelHash then configKey = v; break end
    end

    local offsets = Config.PropOffsets[configKey] and Config.PropOffsets[configKey].dispense or { x = -0.11, startY = 0.15, endY = -0.15, z = 0.95 }

    local startPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmObj, offsets.x, offsets.startY, offsets.z)
    local endPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmObj, offsets.x, offsets.endY, offsets.z)

    print(string.format("^3[ATM DEBUG] Spawning cash at StartPos: %s^0", startPos))

    local prop = CreateObject(model, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z, false, false, false)
    if not DoesEntityExist(prop) then
        print("^1[ATM DEBUG] Failed to create cash prop!^0")
        return
    end

    print("^3[ATM DEBUG] Cash prop created successfully:^0", prop)
    SetEntityHeading(prop, atmHeading + 90.0)
    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)

    local curPosTracker = startPos

    for i = 1, 60 do
        local pct = i / 60.0
        curPosTracker = vector3(
            startPos.x + (endPos.x - startPos.x) * pct,
            startPos.y + (endPos.y - startPos.y) * pct,
            startPos.z + (endPos.z - startPos.z) * pct
        )
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(prop, curPosTracker.x, curPosTracker.y, curPosTracker.z, false, false, false)
        Wait(30)
    end

    print("^3[ATM DEBUG] Cash slide out complete. Waiting to take...^0")

    Wait(2500)

    print("^3[ATM DEBUG] Deleting cash prop.^0")
    DeleteObject(prop)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

function ATM.DepositCashVisual(amount)
    if not ATM.currentATM or not DoesEntityExist(ATM.currentATM) then return end

    local model = `prop_anim_cash_pile_01`
    if amount and amount > 500 then
        model = `prop_cash_pile_02`
    end

    loadModel(model)

    local atmObj = ATM.currentATM
    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmObj)

    local modelHash = GetEntityModel(atmObj)
    local configKey
    for _, v in pairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(v) == modelHash then configKey = v; break end
    end

    local offsets = Config.PropOffsets[configKey] and Config.PropOffsets[configKey].deposit or { x = -0.10, startY = -0.15, endY = 0.15, z = 0.95 }

    local startPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmObj, offsets.x, offsets.startY, offsets.z)
    local endPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmObj, offsets.x, offsets.endY, offsets.z)

    local prop = CreateObject(model, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(prop, atmHeading + 90.0)
    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)

    ATM.PlayAnimation('cardInsert')
    Wait(500)

    for i = 1, 60 do
        local pct = i / 60.0
        local curPos = vector3(
            startPos.x + (endPos.x - startPos.x) * pct,
            startPos.y + (endPos.y - startPos.y) * pct,
            startPos.z + (endPos.z - startPos.z) * pct
        )
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(prop, curPos.x, curPos.y, curPos.z, false, false, false)
        Wait(30)
    end

    Wait(500)
    DeleteObject(prop)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

function ATM.InsertCardVisual(atmEntity)
    if not atmEntity or not DoesEntityExist(atmEntity) then return end

    local model = `prop_cs_credit_card`
    loadModel(model)

    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmEntity)

    local modelHash = GetEntityModel(atmEntity)
    local configKey
    for _, v in pairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(v) == modelHash then configKey = v; break end
    end

    local offsets = Config.PropOffsets[configKey] and Config.PropOffsets[configKey].card or { x = 0.25, startY = -0.10, endY = 0.20, z = 1.2 }

    local startPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmEntity, offsets.x, offsets.startY, offsets.z)
    local endPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmEntity, offsets.x, offsets.endY, offsets.z)

    local prop = CreateObject(model, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(prop, atmHeading)
    SetEntityRotation(prop, 90.0, 90.0, atmHeading, 2, true)
    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)

    for i = 1, 40 do
        local pct = i / 40.0
        local curPos = vector3(
            startPos.x + (endPos.x - startPos.x) * pct,
            startPos.y + (endPos.y - startPos.y) * pct,
            startPos.z + (endPos.z - startPos.z) * pct
        )
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(prop, curPos.x, curPos.y, curPos.z, false, false, false)
        Wait(20)
    end

    Wait(500)
    DeleteObject(prop)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

function ATM.CreateCardVisual(atmEntity)
    if not atmEntity or not DoesEntityExist(atmEntity) then return end

    local model = `prop_cs_credit_card`
    loadModel(model)

    local atmHeading = GetEntityHeading(atmEntity)

    local modelHash = GetEntityModel(atmEntity)
    local configKey
    for _, v in pairs(Config.ATMModels) do
        if GetHashKey(v) == modelHash then configKey = v; break end
    end

    local offsets = Config.PropOffsets[configKey] and Config.PropOffsets[configKey].createCard or { x = 0.25, startY = 0.20, endY = -0.10, z = 1.2 }

    local startPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmEntity, offsets.x, offsets.startY, offsets.z)
    local endPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(atmEntity, offsets.x, offsets.endY, offsets.z)

    local prop = CreateObject(model, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(prop, atmHeading)
    SetEntityRotation(prop, 90.0, 90.0, atmHeading, 2, true)
    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)

    for i = 1, 40 do
        local pct = i / 40.0
        local curPos = vector3(
            startPos.x + (endPos.x - startPos.x) * pct,
            startPos.y + (endPos.y - startPos.y) * pct,
            startPos.z + (endPos.z - startPos.z) * pct
        )
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(prop, curPos.x, curPos.y, curPos.z, false, false, false)
        Wait(20)
    end

    Wait(500)
    DeleteObject(prop)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

function ATM.StartSession(atmEntity)
    if ATM.inSession then return end

    if not atmEntity or not DoesEntityExist(atmEntity) then return end

    local info = Whip.core:Callback('atmdui:start')
    if type(info) ~= 'table' then return end
    ATM.startInfo = info
    if Config.PIN.requireCard and not info.hasCard then
        if Config.PIN.allowCardCreation then
            ATM.StartNoCardSession(atmEntity)
        else
            Whip.core:Notify(Locale('insert_card'), 'error')
        end
        return
    end

    if ATM.lockedUntil > GetGameTimer() then
        Whip.core:Notify(Locale('card_locked'), 'error')
        return
    end

    ATM.inSession = true
    ATM.currentATM = atmEntity
    ATM.pinAttempts = 0
    ATM.enteredPIN = ''
    ATM.enteredAmount = ''
    ATM.transferAccount = ''

    local playerData = { name = ATM.startInfo and ATM.startInfo.name or '', bank = 0 }
    ATM.sessionData = playerData

    local atmModel = GetEntityModel(atmEntity)
    ATM_DUI.ApplyTexture(atmModel)

    ATM_DUI.InitSession(playerData)

    ATM_Camera.TransitionTo(atmEntity)

    ATM.PlayAnimation('cardInsert')
    CreateThread(function()
        ATM.InsertCardVisual(atmEntity)
    end)

    Wait(500)
    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.CARD_INSERT)
    ATM_DUI.SetScreen('card_insert')

    Wait(1500)
    if ATM.inSession then
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.PIN_ENTRY)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('pin_entry', { attempts = Config.PIN.maxAttempts - ATM.pinAttempts })
    end
end

function ATM.StartNoCardSession(atmEntity)
    if ATM.inSession then return end

    ATM.inSession = true
    ATM.currentATM = atmEntity
    ATM.pinAttempts = 0
    ATM.enteredPIN = ''
    ATM.enteredAmount = ''
    ATM.transferAccount = ''

    local playerData = { name = ATM.startInfo and ATM.startInfo.name or '', bank = 0 }
    ATM.sessionData = playerData

    local atmModel = GetEntityModel(atmEntity)
    ATM_DUI.ApplyTexture(atmModel)

    ATM_DUI.InitSession(playerData)

    ATM_Camera.TransitionTo(atmEntity)

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.NO_CARD)
    ATM_DUI.SetScreen('no_card', { cost = Config.PIN.cardCreationCost })
end

function ATM.EndSession()
    if not ATM.inSession then return end

    TriggerServerEvent('atmdui:endSession')

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.CARD_EJECT)
    ATM_DUI.SetScreen('card_eject')

    ATM.PlaySound('cardEject')

    Wait(1500)

    ATM.inSession = false
    ATM.currentATM = nil
    ATM.currentState = ATM.State.IDLE
    ATM.sessionData = {}
    ATM.enteredPIN = ''
    ATM.enteredAmount = ''
    ATM.transferAccount = ''
    ATM.lastTransaction = nil

    ATM_DUI.EndSession()

    ATM_DUI.RemoveTexture()

    ATM_Camera.TransitionBack()
end

function ATM.EnterPINDigit(digit)
    if ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.PIN_ENTRY and ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.CREATE_CARD_PIN then return end
    if #ATM.enteredPIN >= Config.PIN.length then return end

    ATM.enteredPIN = ATM.enteredPIN .. tostring(digit)
    ATM.PlaySound('keyPress')

    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('PIN_UPDATE', { length = #ATM.enteredPIN })
end

function ATM.ClearPIN()
    ATM.enteredPIN = ''
    ATM.PlaySound('keyPress')
    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('PIN_UPDATE', { length = 0 })
end

function ATM.SubmitPIN()
    if ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.PIN_ENTRY then return end
    if #ATM.enteredPIN ~= Config.PIN.length then return end

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.PROCESSING)
    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(true)

    local success, data = Whip.core:Callback('atmdui:verifyPIN', ATM.enteredPIN)
    if success and type(data) == 'table' then
        ATM.sessionData.name = data.name or ATM.sessionData.name
        ATM.sessionData.bank = data.bank or 0
    end

    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(false)

    if success then
        ATM.PlaySound('success')
        ATM.pinAttempts = 0
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.MAIN_MENU)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('main_menu', {
            name = ATM.sessionData.name,
            balance = ATM.sessionData.bank
        })
    else
        ATM.PlaySound('error')
        ATM.pinAttempts = ATM.pinAttempts + 1
        ATM.enteredPIN = ''

        if ATM.pinAttempts >= Config.PIN.maxAttempts then
            ATM.lockedUntil = GetGameTimer() + (Config.PIN.lockoutTime * 1000)
            ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(Locale('card_locked'), 'error')
            Wait(2000)
            ATM.EndSession()
        else
            ATM_DUI.SetScreen('pin_entry', {
                attempts = Config.PIN.maxAttempts - ATM.pinAttempts,
                error = true
            })
            ATM.SetState(ATM.State.PIN_ENTRY)
        end
    end
end

function ATM.EnterAmountDigit(digit)
    if ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.WITHDRAW_AMOUNT and
       ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT and
       ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.TRANSFER_AMOUNT then
        return
    end

    if #ATM.enteredAmount >= 8 then return end

    ATM.enteredAmount = ATM.enteredAmount .. tostring(digit)
    ATM.PlaySound('keyPress')

    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('AMOUNT_UPDATE', { value = ATM.enteredAmount })

function ATM.ClearAmount()

    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('AMOUNT_UPDATE', { value = '0' })
end

function ATM.EnterAccountDigit(digit)
    if ATM.currentState ~= ATM.State.TRANSFER_ACCOUNT then return end
    if #ATM.transferAccount >= 15 then return end

    ATM.transferAccount = ATM.transferAccount .. tostring(digit)
    ATM.PlaySound('keyPress')

    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('AMOUNT_UPDATE', { value = ATM.transferAccount })
end

function ATM.ClearAccount()
    ATM.transferAccount = ''
    ATM.PlaySound('keyPress')
    ATM_DUI.SendMessage('AMOUNT_UPDATE', { value = '0' })
end

function ATM.ProcessWithdraw(amount)
    amount = tonumber(amount)
    if not amount or amount <= 0 then
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(Locale('invalid_amount'), 'error')
        return
    end

    if amount > Config.Transactions.maxWithdraw then
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(Locale('invalid_amount'), 'error')
        return
    end

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.PROCESSING)
    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(true)

    local success, newBalance, message = Whip.core:Callback('atmdui:withdraw', amount)

    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(false)

    if success then
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'playSound', sound = 'dispenser' })
        if ATM_DUI and ATM_DUI.SendMessage then
            ATM_DUI.SendMessage('playSound', { sound = 'dispenser' })
        end

        ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(true, 11000)
        local startTime = GetGameTimer()
        while GetGameTimer() - startTime < 11000 do
            local percent = ((GetGameTimer() - startTime) / 11000.0) * 100
            if ATM_DUI and ATM_DUI.SendMessage then
                ATM_DUI.SendMessage('UPDATE_PROGRESS', { progress = percent })
            end
            Wait(100)
        end
        ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(false)

        ATM.sessionData.bank = newBalance
        ATM.lastTransaction = { type = 'withdraw', amount = amount }
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.SUCCESS)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('success', {
            message = Locale('take_cash'),
            amount = amount,
            newBalance = newBalance
        })

        CreateThread(function()
            ATM.DispenseCash(amount)
        end)

        Wait(2000)
        ATM.ShowReceiptPrompt()
    else
        ATM.PlaySound('error')
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(message or Locale('error'), 'error')
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.MAIN_MENU)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('main_menu', {
            name = ATM.sessionData.name,
            balance = ATM.sessionData.bank
        })
    end
end

function ATM.ProcessDeposit(amount)
    amount = tonumber(amount)
    if not amount or amount <= 0 then
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(Locale('invalid_amount'), 'error')
        return
    end

    if amount > Config.Transactions.maxDeposit then
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(Locale('invalid_amount'), 'error')
        return
    end

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.PROCESSING)
    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(true)

    local success, newBalance, message = Whip.core:Callback('atmdui:deposit', amount)

    ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(false)

    if success then
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'playSound', sound = 'dispenser' })
        if ATM_DUI and ATM_DUI.SendMessage then
            ATM_DUI.SendMessage('playSound', { sound = 'dispenser' })
        end

        ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(true, 8000)

        CreateThread(function()
            Wait(1000)
            ATM.DepositCashVisual(amount)
        end)

        local startTime = GetGameTimer()
        while GetGameTimer() - startTime < 8000 do
            local percent = ((GetGameTimer() - startTime) / 8000.0) * 100
            if ATM_DUI and ATM_DUI.SendMessage then
                ATM_DUI.SendMessage('UPDATE_PROGRESS', { progress = percent })
            end
            Wait(100)
        end
        ATM_DUI.SetProcessing(false)

        ATM.sessionData.bank = newBalance
        ATM.lastTransaction = { type = 'deposit', amount = amount }
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.SUCCESS)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('success', {
            message = Locale('transaction_complete'),
            amount = amount,
            newBalance = newBalance
        })

        Wait(2000)
        ATM.ShowReceiptPrompt()
    else
        ATM.PlaySound('error')
        ATM_DUI.ShowNotification(message or Locale('error'), 'error')
        ATM.SetState(ATM.State.MAIN_MENU)
        ATM_DUI.SetScreen('main_menu', {
            name = ATM.sessionData.name,
            balance = ATM.sessionData.bank
        })

function ATM.ProcessTransfer(targetAccount, amount)

function ATM.HandleReceiptChoice(wantsReceipt)
    if wantsReceipt then

        local info = {
            type = ATM.lastTransaction and ATM.lastTransaction.type or 'unknown',
            amount = ATM.lastTransaction and ATM.lastTransaction.amount or 0,
            account = ATM.lastTransaction and ATM.lastTransaction.to or 'N/A',
            balance = ATM.sessionData.bank or 0
        }
        TriggerServerEvent('atmdui:receipt')
    end

    ATM.SetState(ATM.State.MAIN_MENU)
    ATM_DUI.SetScreen('main_menu', {
        name = ATM.sessionData.name,
        balance = ATM.sessionData.bank
    })
end
