-- SOFTWARE.

Config = {}

-- 'auto' detects qbx_core, qb-core or es_extended. Force one with 'qbox', 'qb' or 'esx'.
Config.Framework = 'auto'

-- 'auto' uses ox_target, then qb-target. 'none' = [E] prompt at the tables of Config.Tables.
Config.Target = 'auto'

-- Language comes from ox_lib: `setr ox:locale en` (or es) in server.cfg.

-- Check xexstudio.com for new versions on start.
Config.CheckForUpdates = true

-- Controls during a match. `label` is the key shown in the HUD.
Config.Controls = {
    push = { control = 38, label = 'E' },  -- tap to push
    leave = { control = 73, label = 'X' }, -- hold to give up
    interact = 38,                         -- opens the table menu when there is no target resource
}

-- Props players can arm wrestle on.
--   world   = true: every prop of this model that already exists on the map can be used (needs a target resource).
--   aligned = true: the prop has two sides, so players stand along its own axis (`axis` = degrees added to the
--             prop's heading). false = round props such as barrels: the challenger stays on the side they came from.
--   offset  moves the centre of the scene from the prop's origin (x to the challenger's right, y towards the
--           rival, z up), in case the hands don't meet over the prop.
Config.Models = {
    prop_arm_wrestle_01 = { world = true, aligned = true, axis = 0.0, offset = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) },
    prop_wooden_barrel = { world = true, aligned = false, offset = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) },
}

-- Tables placed by the script. Each one is a local prop that only exists while a player is close to it.
-- `model` must be listed in Config.Models.
--   board = { coords = vec4(x, y, z, heading), width = 1.6 } (optional): the season's ranking painted on a wall next
--           to the table (top 5 and the champion). coords = centre of the board, heading = where its face looks.
--           Find them with /armwrestlingboard: stand in front of the wall, look at it and copy the line it prints.
Config.Tables = {
    { coords = vec4(-1226.8, -1557.87, 3.19, 303.77), model = 'prop_arm_wrestle_01', blip = true }, -- Vespucci Beach
}

-- Ranking boards on walls: only drawn within this distance, and refreshed every `refresh` seconds while in range.
Config.WallBoard = { distance = 25.0, refresh = 60 }

Config.TableSpawnDistance = 60.0

Config.Blip = { sprite = 311, colour = 46, scale = 0.7 }

Config.Match = {
    challengeDistance = 4.0, -- metres from the table to challenge and to accept
    leaveDistance = 3.0,     -- a player further than this from the table forfeits
    inviteTimeout = 20,      -- seconds to answer a challenge
    countdown = 3,           -- seconds before the match starts
    maxDuration = 45,        -- seconds; at the end whoever is ahead wins
    step = 0.010,            -- how far one full-power push moves the arm (it starts at 0.5: 40 net pushes to win)
    winAt = 0.10,            -- the arm goes from 0 to 1: A wins at 1 - winAt, B wins at winAt
    maxPressRate = 14,       -- pushes per second the server accepts at most
    syncInterval = 150,      -- ms between updates to both players
    leaveHold = 1000,        -- ms the give-up key must be held
}

-- Stamina makes pacing matter. Every push costs stamina and tired pushes are weaker. A steady rhythm (about
-- regen / drain pushes per second) keeps full power; tapping as fast as possible is a burst that empties the bar
-- in a few seconds, so it is worth saving for when the rival is tired or the arm is close to the table.
Config.Stamina = {
    enabled = true,
    drain = 0.035, -- stamina spent per push (stamina goes from 1 to 0)
    regen = 0.20,  -- stamina recovered per second
    floor = 0.30,  -- power of a push with no stamina left (1 = full power)
}

-- Bets with in-game money. The challenger names the amount, both pay when the challenge is accepted and the
-- winner takes both stakes. Cancelled matches and draws are refunded.
-- Accounts: ESX 'money' | 'bank' | 'black_money'. QBCore & Qbox: 'cash' | 'bank'. 'auto' = cash on hand.
Config.Bets = {
    enabled = true,
    account = 'auto',
    max = 5000,
}

-- Ranking. Every player has a rating that starts at `startRating` and moves after each ranked match: beating a
-- higher-rated player gives more, beating a lower-rated one gives less.
Config.Ranking = {
    enabled = true,
    size = 10,          -- players shown in the ranking
    startRating = 1000,
    k = 32,             -- most rating points one match can move
    minMatches = 3,     -- matches needed to appear in the ranking
    minDuration = 4,    -- seconds; shorter matches are not ranked
    pairLimit = 3,      -- ranked matches per hour between the same two players (more are still played, unranked)

    -- Divisions by rating, lowest first. The number one of the season is shown as champion. Labels: locales (div_<key>).
    divisions = {
        { key = 'bronze', min = 0, color = '#c08a5b' },
        { key = 'silver', min = 1050, color = '#b9c3cf' },
        { key = 'gold', min = 1150, color = '#ffc65c' },
        { key = 'diamond', min = 1300, color = '#7fdcff' },
    },
    championColor = '#c5f24a',

    -- Monthly seasons: on the first day of each month the top `hallSize` go to the hall of fame and every rating,
    -- win and loss starts again (best streak and fastest win are all-time records and stay). false = one endless season.
    seasons = true,
    hallSize = 3,
    hallSeasons = 6, -- past seasons shown in the hall of fame
}

-- Tournaments: single elimination at one table, seeded by rating. Hosted at the table (admins, or everyone),
-- players sign up there and the server calls every match. The entry fees make the pot (in-game money, see
-- Config.Bets.account); the winner takes it minus `cut`. Entries are refunded if it is cancelled.
Config.Tournaments = {
    enabled = true,
    host = 'admin',        -- 'admin' (Config.Admin.ace) or 'everyone'
    sizes = { 4, 8, 16 },  -- most players a tournament can take
    minPlayers = 3,        -- fewer when sign-up ends cancels it
    signupSeconds = 180,
    entryMax = 10000,
    cut = 0.0,             -- share of the pot taken out of the economy (0.1 = 10 %)
    callSeconds = 45,      -- time to come to the table when called; then the rival wins by walkover
    joinDistance = 15.0,   -- metres from the table to sign up
    announceDistance = 150.0,
    keepSeconds = 600,     -- the finished bracket stays viewable at the table
    history = 5,           -- last tournaments shown in the hall of fame
}

-- Players near a match see it live: both names, the arm and the stamina bars.
Config.Spectators = {
    enabled = true,
    distance = 15.0,
}

-- Look of the HUD, the result card and the ranking. brand = nil uses the locale text.
Config.UI = {
    brand = nil,
    accent = '#c5f24a',
}

-- Admin command, restricted to this ace. /armwrestlingreset clears the whole ranking.
Config.Admin = {
    ace = 'group.admin',
    reset = 'armwrestlingreset',
    board = 'armwrestlingboard', -- prints the coords for a wall ranking board where the admin is looking
}

-- Hooks for other resources (skills, battle pass, analytics, permissions). Called on the server only
-- (this file is also loaded by clients, which never call them).
Config.Hooks = {
    -- Return false to stop a player from arm wrestling (e.g. on duty, in a safe zone).
    canPlay = nil, -- function(source) return true end

    -- Strength of a player as a multiplier of every push, read once when the match starts.
    -- Clamped between 0.5 and 1.5. Example: a gym skill that gives up to 20 % more.
    power = nil, -- function(source) return 1.0 end

    -- After a match ends with a result.
    -- data = { winner, loser (server ids, nil on a draw), players = { a, b }, reason = 'pin' | 'time' | 'forfeit',
    --          duration (ms), bet, ranked }
    onMatchFinished = nil, -- function(data) end

    -- After a tournament ends. data = { id, name, winner, runnerUp (server ids), players, pot, prize }
    onTournamentFinished = nil, -- function(data) end
}

-- Server: everything declared lives in Whip.register, which runs once whip_core is ready and again after
-- every whip_core restart (whip_core forgets declarations when it restarts).
local ITEM = 'myres_snack'

Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:RegisterItem(ITEM, {
        name     = 'Snack',
        desc     = 'Fills you up a little.',
        weight   = 0.2,
        type     = 'consumable',
        stack    = true,
        maxStack = 10,
        usable   = true,
    })

    -- A table makes a timed use: WHIP shows the bar, plays the anim/prop, times it on the server,
    -- takes the item when the bar ends and runs onComplete. Return false (and why) to give it back.
    Whip.core:RegisterUseHandler(ITEM, {
        label      = 'Eating...',
        duration   = 3000,
        anim       = { dict = 'mp_player_inteat@burger', clip = 'mp_player_int_eat_burger' },
        prop       = { model = 'prop_cs_burger_01', bone = 18905 },
        disable    = { move = false },
        onComplete = function(source)
            return exports.whip_core:AddStat(source, 'hunger', 15, 'item:' .. ITEM)
        end,
    })

    -- The client sends nothing: not the price, not the item. near refuses anyone away from the counter.
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('myres:buy', {
        rateLimit = 1000,
        near = { at = function() return Config.Counter end, range = Config.Range, message = 'Walk up to the counter' },
    }, function(source, player)
        local receipt, err = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(source, Config.Price, { reason = 'Snack' })
        if not receipt then return false, err end           -- the player sees why

        local given, why = exports.whip_core:AddItem(source, ITEM, 1)
        if not given then
            exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt)          -- paid, got nothing: money back
            return false, why
        end
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'Enjoy', 'success')
    end)
end)

-- A command behind Whip.command's gate (rate limit, refused while down, ace/dev); dev = true: the console, or
-- whip.devtools with developer mode on.
Whip.command('myres_give', { dev = true }, function(source, args)
    local target = tonumber(args[1]) or source
    local ok, why = Whip.core:AddItem(target, ITEM, 1, nil, 'admin command')
    if not ok and source > 0 then Whip.core:NotifyPlayer(source, why, 'error') end
end)

Whip.sayStarted()   -- one "started successfully" line, or the problems

-- Server: owns every match. It checks the table and both players, takes and pays the bets, counts the pushes
-- (rate-limited), applies stamina and strength, moves the arm, picks the winner and saves the ranking.
-- The client only reports how many times the push key was tapped and plays what the server decides.
--
-- World props are not visible to the server, so for those it checks the model against Config.Models and that
-- both players really stand next to the coordinates. Tables of Config.Tables are checked against their position.

lib.locale()

local M, S, B = Config.Match, Config.Stamina, Config.Bets
local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local SIDES = { 'a', 'b' }
local OTHER = { a = 'b', b = 'a' }
local TABLE_TOLERANCE = 1.5 -- metres between a placed table and the spot the client reports
local END_MS = 4500         -- the table stays taken while the ending animation plays

local Matches = {}     -- [matchId] = match
local PlayerMatch = {} -- [src] = matchId
local Invites = {}     -- [target] = { from, spot, bet, expires }
local lastCall = {}    -- [src] = GetGameTimer() of the last menu or challenge request
local lastWall = {}    -- [src] = GetGameTimer() of the last wall board refresh
local nextMatchId = 0

-- HELPERS ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function notify(src, key, kind, ...)
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:notify', src, key, kind, ...)
end

local function throttled(src)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastCall[src] and now - lastCall[src] < 250 then return true end
    lastCall[src] = now
    return false
end

local function coordsOf(src)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then return nil end
    return GetEntityCoords(ped)
end

local function near(src, pos, dist)
    local c = coordsOf(src)
    return c ~= nil and #(c - pos) <= dist
end

local function busyAt(pos)
    for _, match in pairs(Matches) do
        if #(match.spot.pos - pos) < 1.0 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function hook(name, ...)
    local fn = Config.Hooks and Config.Hooks[name]
    if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return nil end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if not ok then
        print(('^1[%s] Config.Hooks.%s failed: %s^7'):format(resourceName, name, result))
        return nil
    end
    return result
end

-- A player can play if they exist, have a character, are not downed and are not in another match.
local function available(src)
    return src and GetPlayerName(src) and not PlayerMatch[src] and Bridge.GetIdentifier(src) and not Bridge.IsDead(src)
        and hook('canPlay', src) ~= false
end

-- Normalises the table the client reports: a listed model, numeric coordinates and, for models that are not
-- usable anywhere on the map, a table of Config.Tables at that position.
local function readSpot(data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.model) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    local model = Config.Models[data.model]
    local x, y, z, h = tonumber(data.x), tonumber(data.y), tonumber(data.z), tonumber(data.h) or 0.0
    if not model or not x or not y or not z then return nil end
    local pos = vec3(x, y, z)

    local placed = false
    for _, entry in ipairs(Config.Tables) do
        if entry.model == data.model and #(vec3(entry.coords.x, entry.coords.y, entry.coords.z) - pos) <= TABLE_TOLERANCE then
            placed, h = true, entry.coords.w or h
            break
        end
    end
    if not placed and not model.world then return nil end
    return { model = data.model, pos = pos, h = h % 360.0 }
end

local function angleDiff(a, b)
    local d = math.abs(a - b) % 360.0
    return d > 180.0 and 360.0 - d or d
end

-- Heading of the scene. The challenger (A) stays on the side they came from; on props with two sides the
-- scene snaps to the prop's own axis.
local function sceneHeading(spot, challenger)
    local c = coordsOf(challenger)
    local dx, dy = spot.pos.x - c.x, spot.pos.y - c.y
    local approach = (math.deg(math.atan(-dx, dy)) + 360.0) % 360.0
    local model = Config.Models[spot.model]
    if not model.aligned then return approach end
    local base = (spot.h + (model.axis or 0.0)) % 360.0
    local flipped = (base + 180.0) % 360.0
    return angleDiff(base, approach) <= angleDiff(flipped, approach) and base or flipped
end

-- BETS -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function refund(match)
    if match.bet <= 0 then return end
    for _, side in ipairs(SIDES) do
        if match.paid[side] then
            match.paid[side] = false
            Bridge.AddMoney(match.seats[side], match.bet, B.account, 'arm-wrestling-refund')
        end
    end
end

-- Takes the stake from both players, or from nobody.
local function charge(a, b, bet)
    if bet <= 0 then return true end
    if Bridge.GetMoney(a, B.account) < bet or Bridge.GetMoney(b, B.account) < bet then return false end
    if not Bridge.RemoveMoney(a, bet, B.account, 'arm-wrestling-bet') then return false end
    if not Bridge.RemoveMoney(b, bet, B.account, 'arm-wrestling-bet') then
        Bridge.AddMoney(a, bet, B.account, 'arm-wrestling-refund')
        return false
    end
    return true
end

-- MATCHES ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sendBoth(match, event, ...)
    for _, side in ipairs(SIDES) do
        TriggerClientEvent(event, match.seats[side], match.id, ...)
    end
end

-- SPECTATORS -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local SPECTATE_REFRESH_MS = 1000

local function endSpectators(match, winnerName)
    for src in pairs(match.watchers or {}) do
        TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:spectateEnd', src, match.id, winnerName)
    end
    match.watchers = {}
end

-- Players close to the table (not playing) get the match live. Refreshed about once a second.
local function refreshSpectators(match)
    if not Config.Spectators.enabled then return end
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if match.watchersAt and now - match.watchersAt < SPECTATE_REFRESH_MS then return end
    match.watchersAt = now
    local fresh = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id and not PlayerMatch[id] and near(id, match.spot.pos, Config.Spectators.distance) then
            fresh[id] = true
            if not match.watchers[id] then
                TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:spectate', id, match.id, { names = match.names, bet = match.bet, ranked = match.ranked })
            end
        end
    end
    for id in pairs(match.watchers) do
        if not fresh[id] then TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:spectateEnd', id, match.id) end
    end
    match.watchers = fresh
end

local function release(match)
    for _, side in ipairs(SIDES) do
        local src = match.seats[side]
        if PlayerMatch[src] == match.id then PlayerMatch[src] = nil end
    end
end

-- Ends a match without a result: stakes go back and nothing is saved.
local function cancelMatch(match, reason)
    if match.state == 'ending' then return end
    match.state = 'ending'
    refund(match)
    endSpectators(match)
    sendBoth(match, 'xex_armwrestling:stand', reason)
    release(match)
    Matches[match.id] = nil
    if match.tournament then Tournament.OnMatchEnd(match.tournament, nil, reason) end
end

-- reason = 'pin' | 'time' | 'forfeit'. winner = 'a' | 'b' | nil (draw).
local function finishMatch(match, winner, reason)
    if match.state == 'ending' then return end
    match.state = 'ending'
    local duration = GetGameTimer() - match.startedAt

    if match.bet > 0 then
        if winner then
            match.paid.a, match.paid.b = false, false
            Bridge.AddMoney(match.seats[winner], match.bet * 2, B.account, 'arm-wrestling-win')
        else
            refund(match)
        end
    end

    local ranked = match.ranked and duration >= Config.Ranking.minDuration * 1000
    local rating
    if ranked then
        local ok, result = pcall(Ranking.Record,
            { identifier = match.ids.a, name = match.names.a }, { identifier = match.ids.b, name = match.names.b },
            winner, duration)
        if ok then
            rating = result
        else
            ranked = false
            print(('^1[%s] The match could not be saved: %s^7'):format(resourceName, result))
        end
    end

    for _, side in ipairs(SIDES) do
        local r = rating and rating[side]
        TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:finish', match.seats[side], match.id, {
            outcome = not winner and 'draw' or winner == side and 'win' or 'lose',
            winner = winner,
            reason = reason,
            opponent = match.names[OTHER[side]],
            duration = duration,
            bet = match.bet,
            ranked = ranked,
            rating = r and r.rating,
            delta = r and r.delta,
            streak = r and r.streak,
            fastest = r and r.fastest,
            division = r and r.division,
            promoted = r and r.promoted,
        })
    end
    endSpectators(match, winner and match.names[winner] or nil)

    local data = {
        winner = winner and match.seats[winner] or nil,
        loser = winner and match.seats[OTHER[winner]] or nil,
        players = { match.seats.a, match.seats.b },
        reason = reason, duration = duration, bet = match.bet, ranked = ranked,
    }
    hook('onMatchFinished', data)
    TriggerEvent('xex_armwrestling:matchFinished', data)

    release(match)
    if match.tournament then Tournament.OnMatchEnd(match.tournament, data.winner, reason) end
    SetTimeout(END_MS, function() Matches[match.id] = nil end)
end

-- A player gave up, walked away or disconnected. During the countdown nothing was at stake yet.
local function forfeit(match, side)
    if match.state == 'playing' then
        finishMatch(match, OTHER[side], 'forfeit')
    elseif match.state == 'countdown' then
        cancelMatch(match, 'cancel_left')
    end
end

local function seatProblem(src, pos)
    local c = coordsOf(src)
    if not c or not GetPlayerName(src) then return 'gone' end
    if Bridge.IsDead(src) then return 'dead' end
    if #(c - pos) > M.leaveDistance then return 'far' end
    return nil
end

-- Returns true if the match can go on.
local function checkSeats(match)
    for _, side in ipairs(SIDES) do
        local problem = seatProblem(match.seats[side], match.spot.pos)
        if problem == 'dead' then
            cancelMatch(match, 'cancel_dead')
            return false
        elseif problem then
            forfeit(match, side)
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function runMatch(match)
    local endsAt = GetGameTimer() + M.countdown * 1000
    while GetGameTimer() < endsAt do
        Wait(250)
        if Matches[match.id] ~= match or match.state ~= 'countdown' then return end
        if not checkSeats(match) then return end
    end

    match.state = 'playing'
    match.startedAt = GetGameTimer()
    match.lastPress = { a = match.startedAt, b = match.startedAt }
    sendBoth(match, 'xex_armwrestling:start', match.grade, M.maxDuration)

    local deadline = match.startedAt + M.maxDuration * 1000
    while Matches[match.id] == match and match.state == 'playing' do
        if not checkSeats(match) then return end

        -- A's pushes move the arm up, B's move it down.
        match.grade = math.min(1.0, math.max(0.0, match.grade + (match.push.a - match.push.b) * M.step))
        match.push.a, match.push.b = 0.0, 0.0

        if match.grade >= 1.0 - M.winAt then return finishMatch(match, 'a', 'pin') end
        if match.grade <= M.winAt then return finishMatch(match, 'b', 'pin') end
        if GetGameTimer() >= deadline then
            return finishMatch(match, match.grade > 0.5 and 'a' or match.grade < 0.5 and 'b' or nil, 'time')
        end

        if S.enabled then
            local gain = S.regen * M.syncInterval / 1000
            match.stamina.a = math.min(1.0, match.stamina.a + gain)
            match.stamina.b = math.min(1.0, match.stamina.b + gain)
        end
        sendBoth(match, 'xex_armwrestling:sync', match.grade, match.stamina.a, match.stamina.b)
        refreshSpectators(match)
        local left = math.max(0, math.floor((deadline - GetGameTimer()) / 1000))
        for id in pairs(match.watchers) do
            TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:watchSync', id, match.id, match.grade, match.stamina.a, match.stamina.b, left)
        end
        Wait(M.syncInterval)
    end
end

local function power(src)
    local value = tonumber(hook('power', src)) or 1.0
    return math.min(1.5, math.max(0.5, value))
end

-- opts = { tournament = id } for matches called by a tournament
local function startMatch(a, b, spot, bet, opts)
    nextMatchId = nextMatchId + 1
    local match = {
        id = nextMatchId, spot = spot, bet = bet, state = 'countdown', grade = 0.5,
        tournament = opts and opts.tournament or nil,
        seats = { a = a, b = b },
        ids = { a = Bridge.GetIdentifier(a), b = Bridge.GetIdentifier(b) },
        names = { a = Bridge.GetName(a), b = Bridge.GetName(b) },
        paid = { a = bet > 0, b = bet > 0 },
        push = { a = 0.0, b = 0.0 },
        stamina = { a = 1.0, b = 1.0 },
        power = { a = power(a), b = power(b) },
        watchers = {},
    }
    match.ranked = Ranking.CanRank(match.ids.a, match.ids.b)
    Matches[match.id] = match
    PlayerMatch[a], PlayerMatch[b] = match.id, match.id

    local place = { model = spot.model, x = spot.pos.x, y = spot.pos.y, z = spot.pos.z, h = sceneHeading(spot, a) }
    local info = { names = match.names, bet = bet, ranked = match.ranked, countdown = M.countdown, tournament = match.tournament ~= nil }
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:seat', a, match.id, 'a', place, info)
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:seat', b, match.id, 'b', place, info)
    CreateThread(function() runMatch(match) end)
    return match
end

-- What server/tournament.lua needs from the matches
Matchmaker = {
    Start = startMatch,
    Busy = function(pos) return busyAt(pos) end,
    Available = function(src) return available(src) end,
    Near = function(src, pos, dist) return near(src, pos, dist) end,
}

-- CHALLENGE --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Players who can be challenged at the table, with their character name.
lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:candidates', function(src, data)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    local spot = readSpot(data)
    if not spot or not available(src) or not near(src, spot.pos, M.challengeDistance) then return false end
    if busyAt(spot.pos) or Tournament.Running(spot) then return 'busy' end

    local list = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id ~= src and available(id) and near(id, spot.pos, M.challengeDistance) then
            list[#list + 1] = { id = id, name = Bridge.GetName(id) }
        end
    end
    return list
end)

RegisterNetEvent('xex_armwrestling:challenge', function(target, data, bet)
    local src = source
    if throttled(src) then return end
    target = tonumber(target)
    local spot = readSpot(data)
    if not spot or not target or target == src then return end
    if not available(src) or not near(src, spot.pos, M.challengeDistance) then return end
    if busyAt(spot.pos) or Tournament.Running(spot) then return notify(src, 'table_busy', 'error') end
    if not available(target) or not near(target, spot.pos, M.challengeDistance) then
        return notify(src, 'rival_unavailable', 'error')
    end

    bet = math.floor(tonumber(bet) or 0)
    if not B.enabled then bet = 0 end
    if bet < 0 or bet > B.max then return notify(src, 'bet_invalid', 'error', B.max) end
    if bet > 0 and Bridge.GetMoney(src, B.account) < bet then return notify(src, 'bet_no_funds', 'error') end

    local pending = Invites[target]
    if pending and pending.expires > os.time() then return notify(src, 'rival_pending', 'error') end

    Invites[target] = { from = src, spot = spot, bet = bet, expires = os.time() + M.inviteTimeout }
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:invite', target, Bridge.GetName(src), bet, M.inviteTimeout)
    notify(src, 'challenge_sent', 'inform')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('xex_armwrestling:answer', function(accepted)
    local src = source
    local invite = Invites[src]
    if not invite then return end
    Invites[src] = nil
    local from, pos = invite.from, invite.spot.pos

    if invite.expires < os.time() then return notify(src, 'challenge_expired', 'error') end
    if accepted ~= true then
        if GetPlayerName(from) then notify(from, 'challenge_declined', 'error') end
        return
    end

    local function fail(key)
        notify(src, key, 'error')
        if GetPlayerName(from) then notify(from, key, 'error') end
    end
    if not available(from) or not available(src) or not near(from, pos, M.challengeDistance)
        or not near(src, pos, M.challengeDistance) then
        return fail('not_possible')
    end
    if busyAt(pos) then return fail('table_busy') end
    if not charge(from, src, invite.bet) then return fail('bet_no_funds') end

    startMatch(from, src, invite.spot, invite.bet)
end)

-- PUSHES -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

RegisterNetEvent('xex_armwrestling:press', function(count)
    local src = source
    local match = Matches[PlayerMatch[src]]
    if not match or match.state ~= 'playing' then return end
    count = math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0)
    if count <= 0 then return end

    local side = match.seats.a == src and 'a' or 'b'
    -- Token bucket: at most maxPressRate pushes per second, with one second in reserve so a late packet
    -- doesn't lose pushes.
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local interval = 1000 / M.maxPressRate
    local since = math.max(match.lastPress[side], now - 1000)
    local accepted = math.min(count, math.floor((now - since) / interval))
    if accepted <= 0 then return end
    match.lastPress[side] = since + accepted * interval

    for _ = 1, accepted do
        local stamina = match.stamina[side]
        local strength = S.enabled and (S.floor + (1.0 - S.floor) * stamina) or 1.0
        match.push[side] = match.push[side] + match.power[side] * strength
        if S.enabled then match.stamina[side] = math.max(0.0, stamina - S.drain) end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('xex_armwrestling:leave', function()
    local src = source
    local match = Matches[PlayerMatch[src]]
    if match then forfeit(match, match.seats.a == src and 'a' or 'b') end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = source
    lastCall[src] = nil
    lastWall[src] = nil
    Tournament.Dropped(src)
    Invites[src] = nil
    local match = Matches[PlayerMatch[src]]
    if match then forfeit(match, match.seats.a == src and 'a' or 'b') end
    PlayerMatch[src] = nil
end)

-- RANKING ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:ranking', function(src)
    if throttled(src) or not Config.Ranking.enabled or not Ranking.Ready() then return false end
    local identifier = Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    if not identifier then return false end
    return {
        top = Ranking.Top(), me = Ranking.Personal(identifier), name = Bridge.GetName(src),
        season = Ranking.Season(), hall = Ranking.Hall(), tournaments = Ranking.Tournaments(),
    }
end)

-- TOURNAMENTS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentAt', function(src, data)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    local spot = readSpot(data)
    if not spot then return false end
    return Tournament.Summary(src, spot)
end)

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentCreate', function(src, data, opts)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    local spot = readSpot(data)
    if not spot then return false, 'unavailable' end
    return Tournament.Create(src, spot, opts)
end)

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentJoin', function(src, id)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    return Tournament.Join(src, id)
end)

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentLeave', function(src, id)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    return Tournament.Leave(src, id)
end)

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentCancel', function(src, id)
    if throttled(src) then return false end
    return Tournament.Cancel(src, id)
end)

lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:tournamentView', function(src, id)
    return Tournament.View(id)
end)

-- Ranking boards on walls: the top 5 of the season and the last champion. Cached by Ranking.Top.
lib.callback.register('xex_armwrestling:wall', function(src)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastWall[src] and now - lastWall[src] < 10000 then return false end
    lastWall[src] = now
    if not Config.Ranking.enabled or not Ranking.Ready() then return false end
    local top = {}
    for i, row in ipairs(Ranking.Top()) do
        if i > 5 then break end
        top[i] = { name = row.name, rating = row.rating, wins = row.wins, losses = row.losses, division = row.division, color = row.color }
    end
    local hall = Ranking.Hall()
    local last = hall[1] and hall[1].players[1]
    return { top = top, season = Ranking.Season(), last = last and { name = last.name, season = hall[1].season } or nil }
end)

exports('IsWrestling', function(src) return PlayerMatch[src] ~= nil end)

-- { rating, wins, losses, streak, best_streak, fastest, rank, needed } of a character identifier.
exports('GetStats', function(identifier)
    if type(identifier) ~= 'string' or not Ranking.Ready() then return nil end
    return Ranking.Personal(identifier)
end)

if Config.Admin and Config.Admin.reset then
    lib.addCommand(Config.Admin.reset, {
        help = 'Clears the arm wrestling ranking',
        restricted = Config.Admin.ace,
    }, function(src)
        local removed = Ranking.Reset()
        if src and src > 0 then
            notify(src, 'reset_done', 'success', removed)
        else
            print(('[%s] Ranking cleared (%s players removed).'):format(resourceName, removed))
        end
    end)
end

-- Wall ranking board: the admin looks at a wall and the client prints the Config.Tables line
if Config.Admin and Config.Admin.board then
    lib.addCommand(Config.Admin.board, {
        help = 'Prints the coords of a wall ranking board where you are looking',
        restricted = Config.Admin.ace,
    }, function(src)
        if src and src > 0 then TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:boardCoords', src) end
    end)
end

-- START AND STOP ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CreateThread(function()
    if not Bridge.name then return end
    local ok, err = pcall(Ranking.Init)
    if not ok then
        print(('^1[%s] The ranking table could not be created: %s. Matches still work, unranked.^7'):format(resourceName, err))
        return
    end
    -- A new month closes the season even if the server is not restarted
    while Config.Ranking.seasons do
        Wait(600000)
        pcall(Ranking.CheckSeason)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= resourceName then return end
    for _, match in pairs(Matches) do cancelMatch(match) end
end)

if Config.CheckForUpdates then
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(5000)
        local current = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'version', 0)
        PerformHttpRequest('https://xexstudio.com/api/version/xex_armwrestling?v=' .. current, function(status, body)
            if status ~= 200 or not body then return end
            local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, body)
            if not ok or not data or not data.version then return end
            if data.version ~= current then
                print(('^3[%s] Update available: %s -> %s (https://keymaster.fivem.net)^7'):format(resourceName, current, data.version))
            else
                print(('^2[%s] Up to date (%s).^7'):format(resourceName, current))
            end
        end, 'GET')
    end)
end

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local npcEntity = nil
local uiActive = false
local menuOpen = false

CreateThread(function()
    local model = Config.NPC.model
    if not IsModelInCdimage(model) then return end

    RequestModel(model)
    while not HasModelLoaded(model) do
        Wait(0)
    end

    npcEntity = CreatePed(4, model, Config.NPC.coords.x, Config.NPC.coords.y, Config.NPC.coords.z - 1.0, Config.NPC.coords.w, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(npcEntity, Config.NPC.coords.w)
    FreezeEntityPosition(npcEntity, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(npcEntity, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(npcEntity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local sleep = 1500
        local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)
        local npcCoords = vector3(Config.NPC.coords.x, Config.NPC.coords.y, Config.NPC.coords.z)
        local distance = #(playerCoords - npcCoords)

        if distance < 10.0 then
            if not menuOpen and not IsNuiFocused() then
                if distance < Config.InteractionDistance then
                    sleep = 0

                    if not uiActive then
                        SendNUIMessage({
                            action = 'showInteraction',
                            text = L('interaction_text'),
                            key = L('press_e')
                        })
                        uiActive = true
                    end

                    if IsControlJustPressed(0, Config.MenuOpenKey) then
                        local playerData = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData()
                        local metadata = playerData.metadata or {}

                        if metadata.isdead or metadata.inlaststand then
                            TriggerEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:sendNotify', L('dead_cannot_access'), 'error')
                        else
                            OpenStorageMenu()
                        end
                    end
                else
                    sleep = 500

                    if uiActive then
                        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                        uiActive = false
                    end
                end
            else
                sleep = 1000

                if uiActive then
                    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                    uiActive = false
                end
            end
        else
            sleep = 2000

            if uiActive then
                SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
                uiActive = false
            end
        end

        Wait(sleep)
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if uiActive and not menuOpen and npcEntity then
            Wait(50)

            local npcCoords = GetEntityCoords(npcEntity)
            local onScreen, x, y = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(npcCoords.x, npcCoords.y, npcCoords.z + 1.0)

            if onScreen then
                SendNUIMessage({
                    action = 'updateInteractionPos',
                    x = x * 100,
                    y = y * 100
                })
            end
        else
            Wait(500)
        end
    end
end)

function OpenStorageMenu()
    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getStorages', function(storages)
        if not storages then
            QBCore.Functions.Notify(L('storage_load_error'), 'error')
            return
        end

        if Config.BlurLevel > 0 then
            TriggerScreenblurFadeIn(500)
        end

        menuOpen = true
        SetNuiFocus(true, true)

        SendNUIMessage({
            action = 'openMenu',
            storages = storages,
            pricing = Config.Pricing,
            blurLevel = Config.BlurLevel,
            limits = Config.Limits,
            security = Config.Security,
            defaultImage = Config.DefaultImage,
            locales = Config.Locales,
            locale = Config.Locale
        })
    end)
end

local function CloseMenu()
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(500)
    menuOpen = false
end

RegisterNUICallback('closeMenu', function(_, cb)
    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('createStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.name then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:createStorage', data)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('openStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or (not data.storageId and not data.id) then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    local storageId = data.storageId or data.id

    if data.password and data.password ~= '' then
        TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:openStorage', storageId, data.password)
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:openStorage', storageId)
    end

    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getMembers', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id then
        cb({ success = false, members = {} })
        return
    end

    local resolved = false

    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getMembers', function(members)
        if resolved then return end
        resolved = true
        cb({ success = true, members = members or {} })
    end, data.id)

    SetTimeout(5000, function()
        if resolved then return end
        resolved = true
        cb({ success = false, members = {} })
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('kickMember', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.storageId or not data.citizenid then

        return

RegisterNUICallback('leaveStorage', function(data, cb)

        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:leaveStorage', data.storageId)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('deleteStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:deleteStorage', data.id)
    CloseMenu()
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('notify', function(data, cb)

        QBCore.Functions.Notify(data.text, data.type or 'info')
    end
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:sendNotify', function(text, notifyType)
    if menuOpen then
        SendNUIMessage({
            action = 'notify',
            text = text,
            type = notifyType or 'info'
        })
    else
        QBCore.Functions.Notify(text, notifyType or 'info')
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:refreshStorages', function()
    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getStorages', function(storages)
        SendNUIMessage({
            action = 'updateStorages',
            storages = storages or {}
        })
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('zodi4c-storage:client:openStash', function(stashName)
    if uiActive then
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hideInteraction' })
        uiActive = false
    end

    -- The inventory needs focus, so close the NUI before opening the stash.
    Wait(100)
    exports.ox_inventory:openInventory('stash', stashName)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('updateStorage', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id or not data.name then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:updateStorage', data)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('changePassword', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id or not data.newPass then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:changePassword', data)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('removePassword', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:removePassword', data.id)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('updateStorageCapacity', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.id or not data.slots or not data.weight then
        cb({ success = false })
        return
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('zodi4c-storage:server:updateStorageCapacity', data)
    cb({ success = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getLogs', function(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.storageId then
        cb({})
        return
    end

    QBCore.Functions.TriggerCallback('zodi4c-storage:server:getLogs', function(logs)
        cb(logs or {})
    end, data.storageId)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if resourceName ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end

    if npcEntity and DoesEntityExist(npcEntity) then
        DeleteEntity(npcEntity)
        npcEntity = nil
    end

    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(0)
    menuOpen = false
    uiActive = false
end)

-- Ranking storage. One row per player in `xex_armwrestling` with their rating, record and streaks.
-- The database is read when a player's row or the top is first needed and written once per ranked match.

Ranking = {}

local R = Config.Ranking
local rows = {}    -- [identifier] = row
local top          -- { list = {...}, expires = os.time() }
local pairs_ = {}  -- ['idA|idB'] = { os.time() of each ranked match in the last hour }
local ready = false

local TOP_SECONDS = 30

function Ranking.Init()
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `xex_armwrestling` (
            `identifier` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            `name` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
            `rating` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
            `wins` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `losses` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `streak` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `best_streak` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `fastest` INT NULL,
            `updated_at` DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            INDEX `idx_rating` (`rating`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `xex_armwrestling_hall` (
            `season` VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,
            `position` TINYINT NOT NULL,
            `name` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
            `rating` INT NOT NULL,
            `wins` INT NOT NULL,
            `losses` INT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (`season`, `position`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `xex_armwrestling_meta` (
            `k` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            `v` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `xex_armwrestling_tournaments` (
            `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
            `name` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
            `winner` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
            `winner_identifier` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
            `runner_up` VARCHAR(80) NULL,
            `players` INT NOT NULL,
            `prize` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `finished_at` DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            INDEX `idx_winner` (`winner_identifier`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    ready = true
    Ranking.CheckSeason()
end

-- Current rating of a character (start rating if they never played): tournaments seed with it.
function Ranking.RatingOf(identifier)
    if not ready or not identifier then return R.startRating end
    local ok, row = pcall(function() return rows[identifier] or MySQL.single.await(
        'SELECT rating FROM xex_armwrestling WHERE identifier = ?', { identifier }) end)
    return ok and row and row.rating or R.startRating
end

-- t = { name, winner = { identifier, name }, runnerUp = { name } | nil, players, prize }
function Ranking.SaveTournament(t)
    if not ready then return end
    MySQL.query.await([[
        INSERT INTO xex_armwrestling_tournaments (name, winner, winner_identifier, runner_up, players, prize) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ]], { t.name, t.winner.name, t.winner.identifier, t.runnerUp and t.runnerUp.name or nil, t.players, t.prize })
end

-- Last tournaments for the hall of fame: { { name, winner, runner_up, players, prize } }
function Ranking.Tournaments()
    if not ready or not Config.Tournaments.enabled then return {} end
    return MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT name, winner, runner_up, players, prize FROM xex_armwrestling_tournaments ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?
    ]], { Config.Tournaments.history }) or {}
end

function Ranking.Ready() return ready end

-- Division of a rating: { key, color }. rank 1 of the season (with enough matches) is the champion.
function Ranking.Division(rating, rank)
    if rank == 1 then return { key = 'champion', color = R.championColor } end
    local found = R.divisions[1]
    for _, division in ipairs(R.divisions) do
        if (rating or 0) >= division.min then found = division end
    end
    return found and { key = found.key, color = found.color } or nil
end

-- SEASONS ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function currentSeason() return os.date('%Y-%m') end

local function seasonDaysLeft()
    local now = os.date('*t')
    local nextMonth = os.time({ year = now.month == 12 and now.year + 1 or now.year, month = now.month % 12 + 1, day = 1, hour = 0 })
    return math.max(0, math.ceil((nextMonth - os.time()) / 86400))
end

function Ranking.Season()
    return R.seasons and { id = currentSeason(), daysLeft = seasonDaysLeft() } or nil
end

-- Closes the season when the month changed: the top go to the hall of fame and the ratings start again.
-- Returns true when a season was closed.
function Ranking.CheckSeason()
    if not R.seasons or not ready then return false end
    local season = currentSeason()
    local stored = MySQL.scalar.await("SELECT v FROM xex_armwrestling_meta WHERE k = 'season'")
    if stored == season then return false end
    if stored then
        local best = MySQL.query.await([[
            SELECT name, rating, wins, losses FROM xex_armwrestling
            WHERE wins + losses >= ? ORDER BY rating DESC, wins DESC LIMIT ?
        ]], { R.minMatches, R.hallSize }) or {}
        for i, row in ipairs(best) do
            MySQL.query.await([[
                INSERT IGNORE INTO xex_armwrestling_hall (season, position, name, rating, wins, losses) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ]], { stored, i, row.name, row.rating, row.wins, row.losses })
        end
        MySQL.update.await('UPDATE xex_armwrestling SET rating = ?, wins = 0, losses = 0, streak = 0', { R.startRating })
        rows, top, pairs_ = {}, nil, {}
    end
    MySQL.query.await([[
        INSERT INTO xex_armwrestling_meta (k, v) VALUES ('season', ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE v = VALUES(v)
    ]], { season })
    return stored ~= nil
end

-- Hall of fame: { { season, players = { { position, name, rating, wins, losses } } } }, newest season first.
function Ranking.Hall()
    if not R.seasons then return {} end
    local list = MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT season, position, name, rating, wins, losses FROM xex_armwrestling_hall
        WHERE season IN (SELECT season FROM (SELECT DISTINCT season FROM xex_armwrestling_hall ORDER BY season DESC LIMIT ?) AS recent)
        ORDER BY season DESC, position ASC
    ]], { R.hallSeasons }) or {}
    local out, index = {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        if not index[row.season] then
            index[row.season] = { season = row.season, players = {} }
            out[#out + 1] = index[row.season]
        end
        local players = index[row.season].players
        players[#players + 1] = { position = row.position, name = row.name, rating = row.rating, wins = row.wins, losses = row.losses }
    end
    return out
end

local function load(identifier)
    if rows[identifier] then return rows[identifier] end
    local row = MySQL.single.await(
        'SELECT rating, wins, losses, streak, best_streak, fastest FROM xex_armwrestling WHERE identifier = ?', { identifier })
    row = row or { rating = R.startRating, wins = 0, losses = 0, streak = 0, best_streak = 0 }
    rows[identifier] = row
    return row
end

local function save(identifier, name, row)
    MySQL.query.await([[
        INSERT INTO xex_armwrestling (identifier, name, rating, wins, losses, streak, best_streak, fastest)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), rating = VALUES(rating), wins = VALUES(wins),
            losses = VALUES(losses), streak = VALUES(streak), best_streak = VALUES(best_streak), fastest = VALUES(fastest)
    ]], { identifier, name, row.rating, row.wins, row.losses, row.streak, row.best_streak, row.fastest })
end

local function pairKey(a, b)
    return a < b and (a .. '|' .. b) or (b .. '|' .. a)
end

-- True while the two players still have ranked matches left this hour (Config.Ranking.pairLimit).
function Ranking.CanRank(a, b)
    if not R.enabled or not ready or not a or not b or a == b then return false end
    local list, now, kept = pairs_[pairKey(a, b)] or {}, os.time(), {}
    for _, at in ipairs(list) do
        if now - at < 3600 then kept[#kept + 1] = at end
    end
    pairs_[pairKey(a, b)] = kept
    return #kept < R.pairLimit
end

-- Rating points A wins (B loses the same). score = 1 when A wins, 0 when B wins, 0.5 on a draw.
function Ranking.Delta(ratingA, ratingB, score)
    local expected = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((ratingB - ratingA) / 400))
    return math.floor(R.k * (score - expected) + 0.5)
end

-- Saves a ranked match. a, b = { identifier, name }; winner = 'a' | 'b' | nil (draw); duration in ms.
-- Returns { a = result, b = result } with result = { rating, delta, streak, fastest = true when it is a new best,
-- division, promoted = true when the match moved them up a division }.
function Ranking.Record(a, b, winner, duration)
    local rowA, rowB = load(a.identifier), load(b.identifier)
    local delta = Ranking.Delta(rowA.rating, rowB.rating, winner == 'a' and 1 or winner == 'b' and 0 or 0.5)

    local function apply(row, change, won, lost)
        local fastest = false
        local before = Ranking.Division(row.rating).key
        row.rating = math.max(0, row.rating + change)
        if won then
            row.wins, row.streak = row.wins + 1, row.streak + 1
            row.best_streak = math.max(row.best_streak, row.streak)
            if not row.fastest or duration < row.fastest then
                row.fastest, fastest = duration, true
            end
        elseif lost then
            row.losses, row.streak = row.losses + 1, 0
        end
        local division = Ranking.Division(row.rating)
        return {
            rating = row.rating, delta = change, streak = row.streak, fastest = fastest,
            division = division.key, promoted = change > 0 and division.key ~= before or nil,
        }
    end

    local out = {
        a = apply(rowA, delta, winner == 'a', winner == 'b'),
        b = apply(rowB, -delta, winner == 'b', winner == 'a'),
    }
    save(a.identifier, a.name, rowA)
    save(b.identifier, b.name, rowB)

    local key = pairKey(a.identifier, b.identifier)
    pairs_[key] = pairs_[key] or {}
    pairs_[key][#pairs_[key] + 1] = os.time()
    top = nil
    return out
end

-- Top of the ranking: { { name, rating, wins, losses, best_streak, fastest }, ... }
function Ranking.Top()
    if top and top.expires > os.time() then return top.list end
    local list = MySQL.query.await([[
        SELECT name, rating, wins, losses, best_streak, fastest FROM xex_armwrestling
        WHERE wins + losses >= ? ORDER BY rating DESC, wins DESC LIMIT ?
    ]], { R.minMatches, R.size }) or {}
    for i, row in ipairs(list) do
        local division = Ranking.Division(row.rating, i)
        row.division, row.color = division.key, division.color
    end
    top = { list = list, expires = os.time() + TOP_SECONDS }
    return list
end

-- A player's own numbers. `rank` is nil until they have played Config.Ranking.minMatches matches.
function Ranking.Personal(identifier)
    local row = load(identifier)
    local played = row.wins + row.losses
    local rank
    if played >= R.minMatches then
        rank = (MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xex_armwrestling WHERE wins + losses >= ? AND rating > ?',
            { R.minMatches, row.rating }) or 0) + 1
    end
    local division = Ranking.Division(row.rating, rank)
    return {
        rating = row.rating, wins = row.wins, losses = row.losses, streak = row.streak,
        best_streak = row.best_streak, fastest = row.fastest, rank = rank,
        needed = math.max(0, R.minMatches - played), division = division.key, color = division.color,
    }
end

-- Clears the whole ranking. Returns the number of players removed.
function Ranking.Reset()
    local removed = MySQL.update.await('DELETE FROM xex_armwrestling')
    rows, top, pairs_ = {}, nil, {}
    return removed or 0
end

-- Tournaments: single elimination at one table. Someone hosts it at the table, players sign up there (paying the
-- entry fee, if any), the bracket is seeded by rating and the server calls each match in turn. A player who does
-- not come to the table in time loses by walkover. The winner takes the pot (minus Config.Tournaments.cut).
-- Matches are normal server-side matches (server/main.lua) tagged with the tournament, so every rule still applies.

Tournament = {}

local C = Config.Tournaments
local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local Tournaments = {} -- [id] = tournament
local nextId = 0
local REPLAYS = 2      -- a drawn or cancelled match is played again this many times, then the better seed goes on

local function notify(src, key, kind, ...)
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:notify', src, key, kind, ...)
end

local function online(src)
    return src and GetPlayerName(src) ~= nil
end

local function spotKey(spot)
    return ('%.1f:%.1f:%.1f'):format(spot.pos.x, spot.pos.y, spot.pos.z)
end

local function at(spot)
    local key = spotKey(spot)
    for _, t in pairs(Tournaments) do
        if t.key == key then return t end
    end
end

-- Positions of the seeds in a bracket of `size` (a power of two): 1 v 8, 4 v 5, 2 v 7, 3 v 6...
local function seedOrder(size)
    local order = { 1, 2 }
    while #order < size do
        local n, nextOrder = #order * 2, {}
        for _, seed in ipairs(order) do
            nextOrder[#nextOrder + 1] = seed
            nextOrder[#nextOrder + 1] = n + 1 - seed
        end
        order = nextOrder
    end
    return order
end

function Tournament.SeedOrder(size) return seedOrder(size) end

-- True while a tournament plays at this table (other challenges wait)
function Tournament.Running(spot)
    local t = at(spot)
    return t ~= nil and t.state == 'running'
end

local function announce(t, key, kind, ...)
    local sent = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(t.players) do
        if online(p.src) then
            notify(p.src, key, kind, ...)
            sent[p.src] = true
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id and not sent[id] and Matchmaker.Near(id, t.spot.pos, C.announceDistance) then notify(id, key, kind, ...) end
    end
end

local function refundAll(t)
    for _, p in ipairs(t.players) do
        if t.entry > 0 and online(p.src) then Bridge.AddMoney(p.src, t.entry, Config.Bets.account, 'arm-wrestling-tournament-refund') end
    end
end

local function finishTournament(t, champion, runnerUp)
    t.state = 'finished'
    t.champion = champion
    local prize = math.floor(t.pot * (1.0 - (C.cut or 0.0)))
    if prize > 0 and online(champion.src) then
        Bridge.AddMoney(champion.src, prize, Config.Bets.account, 'arm-wrestling-tournament-prize')
    end
    t.prize = prize
    announce(t, 'tournament_won', 'success', champion.name, t.name)
    pcall(Ranking.SaveTournament, {
        name = t.name, winner = champion, runnerUp = runnerUp, players = #t.players, pot = t.pot, prize = prize,
    })
    local data = {
        id = t.id, name = t.name, winner = champion.src, runnerUp = runnerUp and runnerUp.src or nil,
        players = #t.players, pot = t.pot, prize = prize,
    }
    local fn = Config.Hooks and Config.Hooks.onTournamentFinished
    if type(fn) == 'function' then
        local ok, err = pcall(fn, data)
        if not ok then print(('^1[%s] Config.Hooks.onTournamentFinished failed: %s^7'):format(resourceName, err)) end
    end
    TriggerEvent('xex_armwrestling:tournamentFinished', data)
    -- The finished bracket stays visible at the table for a while
    SetTimeout((C.keepSeconds or 600) * 1000, function()
        if Tournaments[t.id] == t then Tournaments[t.id] = nil end
    end)
end

-- Builds round 1: seeds by rating (best first), byes for the best seeds when the field is not a power of two
local function buildBracket(t)
    table.sort(t.players, function(a, b) return a.rating > b.rating end)
    for i, p in ipairs(t.players) do p.seed = i end
    local size = 2
    while size < #t.players do size = size * 2 end
    local order = seedOrder(size)
    local first = {}
    for i = 1, size, 2 do
        first[#first + 1] = { a = t.players[order[i]], b = t.players[order[i + 1]] }
    end
    t.rounds = { first }
end

local function decide(match, side, reason)
    match.winner = side
    match.reason = reason
end

-- The better seed goes on when nobody can win the match
local function betterSeed(match)
    if not match.b then return 'a' end
    if not match.a then return 'b' end
    return match.a.seed <= match.b.seed and 'a' or 'b'
end

local function nextRound(t)
    local last = t.rounds[#t.rounds]
    if #last == 1 then
        local m = last[1]
        local champion = m[m.winner]
        local runnerUp = m[m.winner == 'a' and 'b' or 'a']
        return finishTournament(t, champion, runnerUp)
    end
    local round = {}
    for i = 1, #last, 2 do
        local x, y = last[i], last[i + 1]
        round[#round + 1] = { a = x[x.winner], b = y[y.winner] }
    end
    t.rounds[#t.rounds + 1] = round
end

local function present(p, t)
    return online(p.src) and Matchmaker.Available(p.src) and Matchmaker.Near(p.src, t.spot.pos, Config.Match.challengeDistance)
end

-- Plays one match of the bracket: calls both players, waits for them and runs it. Returns when it is decided.
local function playMatch(t, match)
    if not match.a or not match.b then return decide(match, match.a and 'a' or 'b', 'bye') end
    for _ = 0, REPLAYS do
        match.called = os.time()
        for _, side in ipairs({ 'a', 'b' }) do
            local p, rival = match[side], match[side == 'a' and 'b' or 'a']
            if online(p.src) then
                notify(p.src, 'tournament_call', 'inform', rival.name, C.callSeconds)
                TriggerClientEvent('xex_armwrestling:tournamentCall', p.src, t.id, rival.name, C.callSeconds)
            end
        end
        local deadline = os.time() + C.callSeconds
        while true do
            if t.state ~= 'running' then return end
            local hereA, hereB = present(match.a, t), present(match.b, t)
            if hereA and hereB and not Matchmaker.Busy(t.spot.pos) then break end
            if os.time() >= deadline or (not online(match.a.src) and not online(match.b.src)) then
                if hereA and not hereB then return decide(match, 'a', 'walkover') end
                if hereB and not hereA then return decide(match, 'b', 'walkover') end
                return decide(match, betterSeed(match), 'walkover')
            end
            if not online(match.a.src) and hereB then return decide(match, 'b', 'walkover') end
            if not online(match.b.src) and hereA then return decide(match, 'a', 'walkover') end
            Wait(1000)
        end

        match.result = nil
        match.live = true
        local game = Matchmaker.Start(match.a.src, match.b.src, t.spot, 0, { tournament = t.id })
        match.live = game ~= nil
        while match.live and t.state == 'running' do Wait(500) end
        if match.result and match.result.winner then
            local side = match.result.winner == match.a.src and 'a' or 'b'
            return decide(match, side, match.result.reason)
        end
        -- Draw or cancelled: play it again
    end
    decide(match, betterSeed(match), 'replays')
end

local function run(t)
    t.state = 'running'
    buildBracket(t)
    announce(t, 'tournament_started', 'inform', t.name, #t.players)
    while t.state == 'running' do
        local round = t.rounds[#t.rounds]
        for _, match in ipairs(round) do
            if t.state ~= 'running' then return end
            if not match.winner then playMatch(t, match) end
        end
        if t.state ~= 'running' then return end
        nextRound(t)
        Wait(2000)
    end
end

-- Called by server/main.lua when a tournament match ends. winner = server id or nil (draw / cancelled).
function Tournament.OnMatchEnd(tournamentId, winner, reason)
    local t = Tournaments[tournamentId]
    if not t or not t.rounds then return end
    for _, match in ipairs(t.rounds[#t.rounds]) do
        if match.live then
            match.result = { winner = winner, reason = reason }
            match.live = false
        end
    end
end

-- HOST, JOIN, LEAVE --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function canHost(src)
    if C.host == 'everyone' then return true end
    return IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'command.' .. Config.Admin.reset)
end

function Tournament.Summary(src, spot)
    if not C.enabled then return nil end
    local t = at(spot)
    local canHostHere = canHost(src) and t == nil
    if not t then return { canHost = canHostHere, sizes = C.sizes, entryMax = C.entryMax } end
    local joined = false
    for _, p in ipairs(t.players) do
        if p.src == src then joined = true end
    end
    return {
        id = t.id, name = t.name, state = t.state, size = t.size, entry = t.entry, players = #t.players,
        joined = joined, host = t.host == src, left = math.max(0, t.endsAt - os.time()),
    }
end

function Tournament.Create(src, spot, opts)
    if not C.enabled then return false, 'tournament_off' end
    if not canHost(src) then return false, 'tournament_no_host' end
    if at(spot) then return false, 'tournament_exists' end
    if not Matchmaker.Near(src, spot.pos, Config.Match.challengeDistance) then return false, 'unavailable' end
    opts = type(opts) == 'table' and opts or {}
    local size = math.floor(tonumber(opts.size) or 0)
    local valid = false
    for _, s in ipairs(C.sizes) do
        if s == size then valid = true end
    end
    if not valid then return false, 'tournament_bad_size' end
    local entry = math.floor(tonumber(opts.entry) or 0)
    if entry < 0 or entry > C.entryMax then return false, 'tournament_bad_entry', C.entryMax end
    local name = type(opts.name) == 'string' and opts.name:gsub('[%c<>]', ''):sub(1, 40) or ''
    if name == '' then name = locale('tournament_default_name') end

    nextId = nextId + 1
    local t = {
        id = nextId, key = spotKey(spot), spot = spot, name = name, size = size, entry = entry, host = src,
        players = {}, pot = 0, state = 'signup', endsAt = os.time() + C.signupSeconds,
    }
    Tournaments[t.id] = t
    announce(t, 'tournament_open', 'inform', name, entry, C.signupSeconds)
    CreateThread(function()
        while t.state == 'signup' and os.time() < t.endsAt and #t.players < t.size do Wait(1000) end
        if t.state ~= 'signup' then return end
        if #t.players < C.minPlayers then
            t.state = 'cancelled'
            refundAll(t)
            announce(t, 'tournament_cancelled', 'error', t.name, C.minPlayers)
            Tournaments[t.id] = nil
            return
        end
        run(t)
    end)
    return true, t.id
end

function Tournament.Join(src, id)
    local t = Tournaments[tonumber(id)]
    if not t or t.state ~= 'signup' then return false, 'tournament_closed' end
    if #t.players >= t.size then return false, 'tournament_full' end
    for _, p in ipairs(t.players) do
        if p.src == src then return false, 'tournament_joined' end
    end
    local identifier = Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    if not identifier or not Matchmaker.Available(src) then return false, 'unavailable' end
    if not Matchmaker.Near(src, t.spot.pos, C.joinDistance) then return false, 'tournament_far' end
    if t.entry > 0 then
        if Bridge.GetMoney(src, Config.Bets.account) < t.entry then return false, 'bet_no_funds' end
        if not Bridge.RemoveMoney(src, t.entry, Config.Bets.account, 'arm-wrestling-tournament-entry') then return false, 'bet_no_funds' end
        t.pot = t.pot + t.entry
    end
    t.players[#t.players + 1] = { src = src, identifier = identifier, name = Bridge.GetName(src), rating = Ranking.RatingOf(identifier) }
    return true
end

function Tournament.Leave(src, id)
    local t = Tournaments[tonumber(id)]
    if not t or t.state ~= 'signup' then return false, 'tournament_closed' end
    for i, p in ipairs(t.players) do
        if p.src == src then
            table.remove(t.players, i)
            if t.entry > 0 then
                t.pot = t.pot - t.entry
                Bridge.AddMoney(src, t.entry, Config.Bets.account, 'arm-wrestling-tournament-refund')
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false, 'tournament_not_joined'
end

-- Host or admin cancels before it starts: everyone gets the entry back
function Tournament.Cancel(src, id)
    local t = Tournaments[tonumber(id)]
    if not t or t.state ~= 'signup' then return false, 'tournament_closed' end
    if t.host ~= src and not IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'command.' .. Config.Admin.reset) then return false, 'tournament_no_host' end
    t.state = 'cancelled'
    refundAll(t)
    announce(t, 'tournament_cancelled_host', 'error', t.name)
    Tournaments[t.id] = nil
    return true
end

-- Bracket for the UI: names only, never server ids or identifiers
function Tournament.View(id)
    local t = Tournaments[tonumber(id)]
    if not t then return nil end
    local function who(p) return p and { name = p.name, seed = p.seed } or nil end
    local rounds = {}
    for r, round in ipairs(t.rounds or {}) do
        rounds[r] = {}
        for i, m in ipairs(round) do
            rounds[r][i] = { a = who(m.a), b = who(m.b), winner = m.winner, reason = m.reason, live = m.live == true }
        end
    end
    local players = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(t.players) do players[i] = p.name end
    return {
        name = t.name, state = t.state, size = t.size, entry = t.entry, pot = t.pot,
        prize = t.prize or math.floor(t.pot * (1.0 - (C.cut or 0.0))), players = players, rounds = rounds,
        bracketSize = t.rounds and #t.rounds[1] * 2 or t.size, left = math.max(0, t.endsAt - os.time()),
        champion = t.champion and t.champion.name or nil,
    }
end

-- A player who disconnects during sign-up leaves the tournament (the entry stays in the pot)
function Tournament.Dropped(src)
    for _, t in pairs(Tournaments) do
        if t.state == 'signup' then
            for i, p in ipairs(t.players) do
                if p.src == src then table.remove(t.players, i) break end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- LD CarWhitelist (client): stops players from getting into a locked seat. The server checks it again.

local STATE = 'ldcwAccess'
local BYPASS_VEHICLE = 'ldCarwhitelistBypass'

Rules.build()

--- What the server says this player may use: bypass, and a set of group indexes.
local function myAccess()
    local s = LocalPlayer.state[STATE]
    local set = {}
    if type(s) == 'table' and type(s.groups) == 'table' then
        for _, gi in pairs(s.groups) do set[tonumber(gi)] = true end
    end
    return type(s) == 'table' and s.bypass == true, set
end

--- Returns nil when the player may use this seat, otherwise the group that locks it.
local function lockedBy(vehicle, seat)
    if vehicle == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return nil end
    if Entity(vehicle).state[BYPASS_VEHICLE] then return nil end
    -- right after joining the server hasn't sent the access yet: don't block (the server still checks)
    if LocalPlayer.state[STATE] == nil then return nil end
    local bypass, set = myAccess()
    if bypass then return nil end
    return Rules.lockedBy(Rules.groupsFor(GetEntityModel(vehicle), GetVehicleClass(vehicle)), set, seat)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function started(res) return GetResourceState(res) == 'started' end

local function notify(message)
    local t = Config.Notify or 'auto'
    if t == 'none' then return end
    if t == 'auto' then
        t = started('ox_lib') and 'ox_lib' or started('es_extended') and 'esx'
            or (started('qb-core') or started('qbx_core')) and 'qb' or 'chat'
    end
    if t == 'ox_lib' then
        TriggerEvent('ox_lib:notify', { title = 'Vehicle', description = message, type = 'error' })
    elseif t == 'esx' then
        TriggerEvent('esx:showNotification', message, 'error')
    elseif t == 'qb' then
        TriggerEvent('QBCore:Notify', message, 'error')
    else
        TriggerEvent('chat:addMessage', { color = { 255, 90, 90 }, args = { 'Vehicle', message } })
    end
end

local lastNotify, lastReport = 0, 0
local function deny(vehicle, seat, group, key)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - lastNotify > 3000 then
        lastNotify = now
        notify(LDCWLText(key, Rules.label(group)))
    end
    if key == 'denied' and now - lastReport > 10000 and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle) then
        lastReport = now
        TriggerServerEvent('ld_carwhitelist:attempt', NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle), seat)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('ld_carwhitelist:removed', function(label)
    lastNotify = GetGameTimer()
    notify(LDCWLText('removed', tostring(label)))
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The check
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function seatOf(ped, vehicle)
    for seat = -1, GetVehicleMaxNumberOfPassengers(vehicle) - 1 do
        if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat) == ped then return seat end
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local wait = 300
        local ped = PlayerPedId()

        -- trying to get in: stop it before the door opens
        local target = GetVehiclePedIsTryingToEnter(ped)
        if target ~= 0 then
            wait = 50
            local seat = GetSeatPedIsTryingToEnter(ped)
            local group = lockedBy(target, seat)
            if group then
                ClearPedTasks(ped)
                deny(target, seat, group, 'denied')
            end
        end

        -- already inside (warped in by a script, access just taken away, ...): get out
        local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
        if vehicle ~= 0 then
            local seat = seatOf(ped, vehicle)
            local group = seat and lockedBy(vehicle, seat)
            if group then
                -- never out of a flying aircraft or a moving car: wait until it (nearly) stands still
                if GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) < 3.0 and not IsEntityInAir(vehicle) then
                    TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)
                end
                deny(vehicle, seat, group, 'removed')
                wait = 1000
            end
        end

        Wait(wait)
    end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exports
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- exports.ld_carwhitelist:canUse(vehicle, seat) -> true | false, groupLabel   (seat default -1 = driver)
exports('canUse', function(vehicle, seat)
    local group = lockedBy(vehicle, seat or -1)
    return group == nil, group and group.label
end)

--[[
    LD CarWhitelist - configuration

    Lock vehicles to jobs or ACE permissions. Players without access can't get in: the game stops them
    while they try to enter, and the server checks again and removes anyone who got in anyway.

    Works with ESX, QBCore and Qbox (detected automatically). Without a framework, use ACE permissions.
]]

Config = {}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- General
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Locale = 'en'            -- en, nl, de, fr, es, pt, pl, tr
Config.VersionCheck = true      -- tell you in the server console when a new version is available
Config.Debug = false

-- Players with this ACE may use every vehicle (staff). `add_ace group.admin ldcw.bypass allow`
Config.BypassAce = 'ldcw.bypass'

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Groups
--   models     spawn names. Checked by the game AND by the server.
--   classes    vehicle classes, e.g. { 18 } = all emergency vehicles. Checked by the game only
--              (the server can't read classes), so list important models under `models` as well.
--   jobs       job name = minimum grade (0 = every grade)
--   ace        players with this ACE permission may always use the group (nil = none)
--   onDuty     true = jobs only count while on duty (QBCore/Qbox duty, ESX when your ESX has it)
--   seats      'driver' = only driving is locked, passengers may get in (e.g. someone under arrest)
--              'all'    = every seat is locked
--   A vehicle in several groups may be used by anyone with access to one of them.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Groups = {
    {
        label = 'Police',
        models = { 'police', 'police2', 'police3', 'police4', 'policeb', 'policet', 'policeold1', 'policeold2',
            'sheriff', 'sheriff2', 'fbi', 'fbi2', 'pranger', 'riot', 'riot2', 'polmav', 'predator' },
        classes = {},
        jobs = { police = 0, sheriff = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.police',
        onDuty = false,
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    {
        label = 'EMS',
        models = { 'ambulance', 'lguard' },
        jobs = { ambulance = 0, ems = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.ems',
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    {
        label = 'Fire department',
        models = { 'firetruk' },
        jobs = { fire = 0, firefighter = 0, ambulance = 0 },
        ace = 'ldcw.fire',
        seats = 'driver',
    },
    -- {
    --     label = 'Mechanic',
    --     models = { 'towtruck', 'towtruck2', 'flatbed' },
    --     jobs = { mechanic = 0 },
    -- },
}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Server check
--   Every few seconds the server looks at who is driving what, and removes players without access.
--   This also catches players who were put into a vehicle by a script or a cheat.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.ServerCheck = true
Config.ServerCheckInterval = 1500   -- milliseconds

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications
--   'auto' = ox_lib, then ESX, then QBCore/Qbox, then chat. Or 'ox_lib' | 'esx' | 'qb' | 'chat' | 'none'
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Notify = 'auto'

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Discord log (optional): a message when the server had to remove someone, or someone tried to get in.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Config.Webhook = {
    Url = '',                   -- or `set ldcwl_webhook "..."` in server.cfg (that one wins)
    Cooldown = 60,              -- seconds between two messages about the same player
    LogAttempts = true,         -- also log blocked attempts to get in (not only removals)
}
